controls_moving_around.title: CONTROLS: MOVIN' AROUND
controls_moving_around.description:
ARROWS OR WASD MOVE. Z OR ENTER CONFIRMS AN' TALKS, X OR ESCAPE CANCELS. HOLD SHIFT TA RUN.

RUNNIN' SPENDS AP, DA SAME METER BATTLE SKILLS USE. WALK OR STAND STILL TA REFILL IT.

Z ACTS ON WHATEVER YOU FACE. Z ON A COMPANION OPENS DEY EMPATHIZE SHEET.

C KICKS. KICKS BREAK CRATES, FORCE DOORS AN' SHOVE OBJECTS. IF NUTTIN' MAKES A SOUND, IT NO CAN BE KICKED. LOCKED DOORS TAKE SEVERAL KICKS!

controls_menu_hotkeys.title: CONTROLS: MENU HOTKEYS
controls_menu_hotkeys.description:
TAB OPENS DA MENU. EACH SCREEN ALSO HAB A LETTER, PRESSED ON DA MAP:

- ME LOOT SACK, C CHARACTER, R EQUIPMENT, P SKILLS, J QUESTS
- M MINIMAP, B BUILD, V VEHICLES, F FACTIONS, H HOLDINGS
- K COOKIN', L DIS BOOK, N TRAININ', Y BESTIARY, U BIOLOGICS
- O FIDDLY BITS, G SANDBOX (TESTER BUILDS)

INSIDE DA MENU: 1 THINKER, 2 MULTIPLAYER, 3 HYPERNET. ON DA MAP, 1 TA 9 FIRE DA QUICK BAR.

WASD, Z, X, Q, E AN' T IZ RESERVED. F9 QUICKSAVE, F10 QUICKLOAD, F11 FULLSCREEN!

controls_mouse.title: CONTROLS: MOUSE
controls_mouse.description:
DA MOUSE DOES NO MOVE YA CHARACTER.

- DRAG PANS DA CAMERA, IT SNAPS BACK WHEN YOU WALK
- WHEEL ZOOMS, WORLD MAP ONLY
- HOVER SHOWS AN EVENT'S LABEL, ALT LABELS DEM ALL

IN BATTLE: LEFT CLICK AN BAD 'UN TA HIT IT WIT DA SELECTED COMMAND, RIGHT CLICK CYCLES COMMANDS, WHEEL SCROLLS, 1 TA 5 FIRE.

MENUS IZ CLICKABLE THROUGHOUT!

controls_controller.title: CONTROLS: CONTROLLER
controls_controller.description:
A CONTROLLER WORKS EVERYWHERE, MENUS, STAR MAP AN' 3D MINIGAMES INCLUDED.

- LEFT STICK MOVES AN' NAVIGATES, RIGHT STICK PANS
- R3 LABELS EVERY EVENT ON SCREEN
- L2 / R2 ZOOM DA WORLD MAP, DA RIGHT STICK SCROLLS LONG OVERLAYS
- L1 / R1 CYCLE TABS, CHANGE CHARACTER, STEP DA QUICK BAR

ONE TINK STILL NEEDS A MOUSE: OPENIN' A SEARCH FIELD!

controls_remapping.title: CONTROLS: REMAPPIN'
controls_remapping.description:
FIDDLY BITS, COMMANDS PAGE. KEYBOARD AN' GAMEPAD REMAP SEPARATELY, AN' EVERY DEFAULT COMMAND CAN BE REBOUND.

DA ONES ADDED HERE: ZOOM IN (Q, LB), ZOOM OUT (E, RB), KICK (C, RT), RUN (SHIFT, LT).

BINDINGS IZ KEPT WIT YA FIDDLY BITS!

what_is_on_the_screen.title: WHAT IZ ON DA SCREEN
what_is_on_the_screen.description:
DA PARTY HUD SITS TOP LEFT, ON DA MAP AN' IN BATTLE: NAME, LEVEL, HP, AP ORB, MP. DA ACTIN' MEMBER IZ LIT.

CHIPS RUN BESIDE EACH CARD. HUNGER, SLEEP, HYGIENE, CRAVINGS AN' ILLNESS ON DA MAP; STAT CHANGES, CLASS RESOURCES AN' STATES IN BATTLE. DEY COLOUR PAST DA WARNIN' LINE AN' AGAIN PAST DA CRITICAL ONE.

WHILE RIDIN', DA VEHICLE TAKES A ROW ABOVE DA CREW, FUEL WHERE MAGIC WOULD BE.

DA QUICK BAR SITS BOTTOM CENTRE: ITEMS ON DA MAP, SKILLS IN BATTLE.

NOTIFICATIONS IZ PARCHMENT CARDS. TRANSIENT ONES FADE; STANDIN' ONES STAY WHILE DEY IZ TRUE.

DA HUD CAN BE SWITCHED OFF IN FIDDLY BITS, VIDEO!

searching_inside_menus.title: SEARCHIN' INSIDE MENUS
searching_inside_menus.description:
EVERY LONG LIST HAB A SEARCH BAR, DIS BOOK INCLUDED. IT STARTS AS A MAGNIFIER AT DA TOP OF DA PAGE.

- WHILE TYPIN', MENU HOTKEYS IZ OFF
- ESCAPE CLEARS DA FIELD, ESCAPE AGAIN LEAVES IT

DA MAIN MENU SEARCH COVERS SEVERAL SCREENS AT ONCE: CARRIED ITEMS, COMPANIONS' GEAR, SKILLS, RECIPES YOU CAN MAKE NOW, BESTIARY CREATURES!

saving,_autosave_and_quicksaves.title: STASHIN', AUTOSAVE AN' QUICKSAVES
saving,_autosave_and_quicksaves.description:
DA GAME AUTOSAVES ON MAP CHANGE, AT MOST ONCE EVERY FEW MINUTES, INTO AN ORDINARY SLOT.

F9 QUICKSAVES, F10 QUICKLOADS, OVER THREE ROTATIN' SLOTS DAT ANY PLAYTHROUGH MAY OVERWRITE.

DELETIN' A PERMADEATH STASH LEAVES ITS DIARY BEHIND!

worlds_and_savegames.title: WORLDS AN' SAVEGAMES
worlds_and_savegames.description:
A WORLD IZ A FOLDER, AN' SEVERAL CAN SIT SIDE BY SIDE. MAKE DEM FROM DA WORLDS SCREEN. UNTIL ONE EXISTS, EXPLORE, RECONNECT, STORY MODE AN' SANDBOX STAY GREYED OUT.

A WORLD IZ GENERATED IN FULL BEFORE IT IZ PLAYED: A CENTURY OF HISTORY, PEOPLE, HOMES, JOBS, SHOP ROTAS, DA DUNGEON, POLITICS, FACTIONS, EPIDEMICS.

EVERY PLAYTHROUGH IN DAT WORLD WALKS INTO DA SAME PLACE, ALREADY CHANGED BY DA ONES BEFORE IT. DA CLOCK ONLY MOVES FORWARD, SO A LOADED STASH RESUMES FROM DA LATEST DATE REACHED DERE.

OTHER PLAYTHROUGHS APPEAR IN PERSON, STANDIN' WHERE DEY WAZ LAST STASHED!

options.title: FIDDLY BITS
options.description:
FIDDLY BITS IZ SPLIT INTO TABS:

- VIDEO: RESOLUTION, FULLSCREEN, PIXEL PERFECT SCALIN', RETRO SHADER, UI SCALIN', PARTY HUD
- AUDIO: VOLUMES, BATTLE MUSIC PICKER
- GAMEPLAY: PARTY FORMATION, AUTO IDLE EXPLORER, WORLD MAP HINTS
- COMMANDS: KEYBOARD AN' GAMEPAD REMAPPIN'
- EXPERIMENTAL: INCLUDES A LOCAL LANGUAGE MODEL DAT WRITES NPC DIALOGUE

FULLSCREEN IZ ON DA FIRST TIME DA GAME RUNS, DEN KEEPS YA FIDDLY BIT!

mods_and_updates.title: MODS AN' UPDATES
mods_and_updates.description:
MODS GO IN DA MODS FOLDER NEXT TA DA EXECUTABLE. A MOD CAN REPLACE DATA, ADD PICTURES OR ADD CONTENT. DESKTOP BUILD ONLY.

IN DA MOD MANAGER, ENTER TOGGLES A MOD AN' ARROWS CHANGE DA LOAD ORDER. DA BOTTOM OF DA LIST WINS.

UPDATES ON DA TITLE SCREEN DOWNLOADS ONLY DA FILES DAT CHANGED. REPLACED FILES IZ BACKED UP, AN' DA GAME MUST BE RESTARTED. PICK DA STABLE OR UNSTABLE CHANNEL, OR RESTORE ANY EARLIER BUILD!

the_party.title: DA PARTY
the_party.description:
THREE MEMBERS. DA FIRST IZ DA LEADER: DA ONE YOU STEER, WHOSE NEEDS DRAIN FASTEST AN' WHO NPCS TALK TA.

A FOURTH COMPANION CAN WALK ALONG WITOUT BEING A MEMBER. IT NEVER FIGHTS AN' NO CAN BE HURT.

EACH MEMBER HAB DEY OWN NEEDS, OPINIONS, REPUTATION, SPECIALIZATIONS AN' RELATIONSHIPS WIT DA OTHER TWO.

SET FORMATION IN FIDDLY BITS. CLOSE KEEPS EVERYONE BEHIND DA LEADER; LOOSE LETS DEM WANDER AN' REGROUP OFF SCREEN. LOOSE MEMBERS LOOK AFTER THEMSELVES WHEN A NEED RUNS LOW, PAYIN' FROM DA PARTY'S MONEY.

RUN FOR A MOMENT TA CALL EVERYONE BACK. FACE A COMPANION AN' CONFIRM TA OPEN DEY EMPATHIZE SHEET!

making_your_characters.title: MAKIN' YA CHARACTERS
making_your_characters.description:
CHARACTERS IZ MADE ONE AT A TIME, THREE WAYS:

- QUICK: LOOK, CLASS, TRAITS, GEAR
- DOSSIERS: PRE-MADE CHARACTERS, SOME REUSABLE IN ANY WORLD, DA REST SPENT ONCE USED. A DOSSIER MAY BRING A VEHICLE, A HOMETOWN AN' ALTERNATE SKINS
- DETAILED: DA WHOLE SHEET, DOWN TA IDEOLOGY, MORALITY, ORIENTATION AN' BACKSTORY

STARTIN' GEAR IZ PICKED BY PRICE, NO POWER: DA CHEAPEST WEAPON OF EACH TYPE, ON A FIXED BUDGET PER CLASS. TRAIT GEAR IZ GRANTED ON TOP!

classes.title: CLASSES
classes.description:
A CLASS SETS STARTIN' STATS, DA SCHOOLS YOU LEARN FASTEST AN' A FAVOURED ELEMENT.

EACH CLASS HAB A PRIMARY AN' A SECONDARY CATEGORY. PRIMARY SKILLS PROGRESS FASTEST AN' COST LEAST, SECONDARY ONES PROGRESS FASTER AT NORMAL PRICE. SKILLS FROM OTHER SCHOOLS NEED A KNOWN SKILL IN DAT SCHOOL FIRST AN' COST MUCH MORE.

TRAININ' LISTS YA CLASS CURRICULUM, BUT OTHER SKILLS CAN STILL BE LEARNED.

ANY CLASS CAN EQUIP ANY WEAPON. WEAPON SKILL IZ TRAINED SEPARATELY.

CREATURE CLASSES IZ A SEPARATE SET: FERAL, MIMIC, MONSTER, MANA CYBORG, GHOST, ZOMBIE, MUTANT, DRONE. A CHARACTER WIT ONE OF DEM COUNTS AS AN ANIMAL!

traits.title: TRAITS
traits.description:
TRAITS IZ BOUGHT AT CREATION FROM A POOL OF POINTS. POSITIVE TRAITS COST, NEGATIVE TRAITS PAY BACK, SO DRAWBACKS FUND VIRTUES.

DEY CHANGE BASE STATS AN' GRANT SKILLS, ITEMS AN' GEAR, AN' DEY IZ READ DURIN' PLAY: NPC FIRST IMPRESSIONS, HOW MUCH ANYONE MINDS YA CONDITION, WHICH SPECIALIZATIONS START AHEAD, WHAT COMPANIONS DO WIT DEY FREE TIME.

TRAITS IZ PERMANENT!

attributes.title: ATTRIBUTES
attributes.description:
SIX ATTRIBUTES:

- STR: CARRYIN' CAPACITY, PHYSICAL DAMAGE
- CON: DAMAGE ABSORBED, HOW LONG A CHOKE IZ HELD
- DEX: SPEED, PRECISION, EVASION, ESCAPIN' HOLDS
- INT: LEARNIN', MATHEMATICAL MAGIC
- WIS: JUDGEMENT, RESISTANCE, INTUITIVE MAGIC
- PSI: LUCK. BAD 'UN REACTIONS, LOOT ROLLS, HIDDEN ROLLS IN YA FAVOUR

DA BATTLE HUD SHOWS DA MODIFIER AS A MULTIPLIER (STR 1.4X)!

playing_a_creature.title: PLAYIN' A CREATURE
playing_a_creature.description:
A PARTY MEMBER CAN BE A CREATURE, BUILT FROM ONE ARCHETYPE OR TWO CROSSED.

DA ARCHETYPE SETS DA BODY: DAT SPECIES' PARTS, REACH, HANDS AN' WEAK POINTS.

A CREATURE CLASS IZ NON SENTIENT: NO CONVERSATION, POLITICS, SAVINGS OR PROPERTY. A CIVILISED CLASS IZ A PERSON SHAPED LIKE AN ANIMAL, AN' IZ TREATED AS A PERSON.

ANATOMY AFFECTS PLAY. IT DECIDES HOW MANY WEAPONS CAN BE HELD, WHETHER YOU CAN BE CHOKED, AN' WHAT A PREGNANCY PRODUCES!

portraits_and_3d_models.title: PORTRAITS AN' 3D MODELS
portraits_and_3d_models.description:
EACH CHARACTER IZ DRAWN ONE OF THREE WAYS, CHOSEN AT CREATION AN' NEVER MIXED:

- BUST: HAND DRAWN PORTRAIT
- MODEL: PROCEDURAL 3D BODY. EACH LIMB CAN TAKE DA MATCHIN' PART OF ANY REGISTERED CREATURE, WIT SLIDERS FOR HEIGHT, BUILD, EARS, NOSE AN' SKIN
- SPRITE: USED BY MONSTERS, RECRUITED BAD 'UNS AN' SUMMONS, SHOWN AS DA 3D MODEL OF DEY SPECIES

DA STATUS SCREEN, DA DIALOGUE BUSTS AN' DA EMPATHIZE PANEL ALL USE IT!

recruiting_people.title: RECRUITIN' PEOPLE
recruiting_people.description:
THREE WAYS INTO DA PARTY: TALK A MONSTER ROUND IN BATTLE, ASK A TOWNSPERSON THROUGH EMPATHIZE ONCE DEY TINK WELL ENOUGH OF WHOEVER IZ ASKIN', OR ADOPT A CREATURE AN' TRAIN IT UP.

A RECRUITED TOWNSPERSON LEAVES DA MAP FOR GOOD. DEY PROFILE, PERSONALITY, TRAITS, SKILLS, WEALTH, HISTORY AN' STANDIN' ALL MOVE INTO DA PARTY ACTOR.

DA PARTY HOLDS THREE, SO SOMEONE MUST LEAVE FOR SOMEONE TA JOIN. RETIRED MEMBERS GO BACK TA DA DOSSIER BOARD!

pets,_followers_and_children.title: PETS, FOLLOWERS AN' CHILDREN
pets,_followers_and_children.description:
A FOURTH COMPANION FOLLOWS DA PARTY WITOUT BEING A MEMBER. IT NEVER FIGHTS, NO CAN DIE AN' NO CAN BE TARGETED.

A FOLLOWER IZ A CREATURE RECRUITED FROM A MONSTER DAT TALKS, A PET ONE FROM A MONSTER DAT DOES NO, A CHILD DA RESULT OF A PREGNANCY.

ONLY ONE WALKS WIT YOU AT A TIME; DA FOLLOWERS PAGE SWAPS AN' RELEASES DEM.

PETS AN' FOLLOWERS CAN BE TRAINED INTO PARTY MEMBERS, AT CLASSES DA SPECIES ROSTER ALLOWS. TRAININ' IZ MEASURED IN WORLD CLOCK MINUTES, ANIMAL TRAININ' OR LEADERSHIP SHORTENS IT, AN' ONLY DA COMPANION CURRENTLY WALKIN' WIT YOU MAKES PROGRESS. CHILDREN AN' SUMMONS IZ NEVER TRAINED!

reproduction_and_pregnancy.title: REPRODUCTION AN' PREGNANCY
reproduction_and_pregnancy.description:
EVERY BODY HAB A REPRODUCTIVE TYPE, SET BY ITS SPECIES:

- TESTICLES: FERTILITY DEPENDS ON HORMONES AN' CONDITION
- UTERUS: A MONTHLY CYCLE WIT A FEW FERTILE DAYS
- OVIPAROUS: LAYS A CLUTCH OF EGGS
- PLANT: MAKES SEEDS DAT PILE UP UNTIL PLANTED
- MITOSIS: DA BODY DIVIDES INTO A COPY

A PREGNANCY LASTS AS LONG AS DA SPECIES NEEDS. BIOLOGICS SHOWS ITS PROGRESS, SYMPTOMS ARRIVE AS STATES, AN' DA HEART RATE CLIMBS.

NEWBORNS APPEAR IN FOLLOWERS AS CHILDREN WIT DA PARENT'S FACE. MITOSIS MAKES A COPY OF DA PARENT!

death,_gravestones_and_permadeath.title: DEATH, GRAVESTONES AN' PERMADEATH
death,_gravestones_and_permadeath.description:
FALLIN' IN BATTLE IZ NO AUTOMATIC DEATH. HEALTH PROTECTION AN' DANGER WARNINGS LET YOU BREAK OFF, AN' FLEEIN' ALWAYS WORKS.

A DEAD CHARACTER LEAVES A GRAVESTONE WHERE DEY FELL. IT STAYS ON DA MAP AN' IZ WHERE RESTORATION IZ PERFORMED.

UNDER PERMADEATH DA CHARACTER IZ GONE FOR GOOD AN' DEY QUICKSAVES WIT DEM. A WIPED PARTY ENDS DAT PARTY ONLY; DA NEXT STARTS IN DA SAME CHANGED WORLD.

LOST LIMBS IZ NO DEATH AN' HEALIN' DOES NO PUT DEM BACK!

what_your_companions_say.title: WHAT YA COMPANIONS SAY
what_your_companions_say.description:
TWO OR MORE COMPANIONS CHAT 'BOUT WHAT IZ GOING ON: A RECENT PURCHASE, LOW HEALTH, A NEED RUNNIN' LOW, SOMETINK FROM DA DIARY, DA BIOME, DA ROAD, MONEY, DA LEADER, DA PLAN.

PERSONALITY SHAPES EACH LINE, SO DA SAME TOPIC PLAYS OUT DIFFERENTLY DEPENDIN' ON WHO IZ IN DA PARTY.

DEY ALSO TALK WHILE DRIVIN' AN' ON TRAINS, COACHES AN' TAXIS. A PARTY OF ONE TALKS TA ITSELF!

the_auto_explorer.title: DA AUTO EXPLORER
the_auto_explorer.description: AN FIDDLY BITS TOGGLE PLAYS DA GAME FOR YOU WHILE YOU IZ IDLE. DA PARTY EXPLORES, CROSSES DA MAP AN' LOOKS AFTER ITS NEEDS DA WAY A LOOSE COMPANION DOES, PAYIN' DA SAME COSTS YOU WOULD, AN' GIVES CONTROL BACK AS SOON AS YOU PRESS ANY KEY!

levels_and_experience.title: LEVELS AN' EXPERIENCE
levels_and_experience.description:
EXPERIENCE COMES FROM WINNIN' FIGHTS, AN' A LEVEL RAISES DA SIX ATTRIBUTES AN' DA HP AN' MP POOLS.

LEVELS IZ A LIL' PART OF POWER. SKILLS LEARNED, SPECIALIZATIONS TRAINED, GEAR CARRIED AN' DA CONDITION OF DA BODY ALL MATTER MORE!

knowledge_points.title: KNOWLEDGE POINTS
knowledge_points.description:
KNOWLEDGE POINTS (KP) BUY SKILLS AN' IZ SHARED BY DA WHOLE PARTY. YOU EARN DEM FROM FIGHTS, QUESTS, ADVENTURES, DREAMS AN' RAMAN SCANS.

STRONGER SKILLS COST MORE. ESOTERIC AN' FORBIDDEN SKILLS COST FAR MORE.

SKILLS FROM YA PRIMARY SCHOOL IZ CHEAPEST, SECONDARY ONES COST DA NORMAL PRICE, OTHER SCHOOLS COST DA MOST!

the_atlas_of_circles.title: DA ATLAS OF CIRCLES
the_atlas_of_circles.description:
SKILLS IZ LAID OUT AS A SPHERE GRID. EACH SCHOOL IZ A CIRCLE: RINGS RUN FROM ITS WEAKEST SKILLS OUTWARD TA ITS STRONGEST, WIT UPGRADE BRANCHES ON DA RIM.

YOU CAN BUY A SKILL ONLY IF IT IZ NEXT TA ONE YOU KNOW. DA INNER RING OF EVERY SCHOOL IZ ALWAYS OPEN.

FORBIDDEN SKILLS SIT ALONE IN DA CENTRE. DEY OPEN ONLY ONCE YOU KNOW DA WHOLE SCHOOL.

ONE SCHOOL AT A TIME: USE DA PAGER OR WALK OFF DA RIM. WHEEL AN' SHIFT ZOOM, DRAG PANS!

training_and_progression.title: TRAININ' AN' PROGRESSION
training_and_progression.description: EACH MEMBER TRAINS ONE SKILL AT A TIME. WINNIN' BATTLES AN' USING SKILLS OF DA SAME CATEGORY BOTH ADVANCE IT. PRIMARY CATEGORIES TRAIN FASTEST, SECONDARY ONES FASTER DEN DA REST!

specializations.title: SPECIALIZATIONS
specializations.description:
HUNDREDS OF SPECIALIZATIONS, FROM WRESTLIN' TA ACCOUNTIN' TA BEEKEEPIN'. EACH USES ONE ATTRIBUTE AN' HAB FIVE TIERS, UNTRAINED TA MASTER.

YA LEVEL IZ DA HIGHEST OF: TRAINED THROUGH PLAY, GRANTED BY CLASS, GRANTED BY A TRAIT.

DEY TRAIN BY DOING. COOKIN' RAISES COOKIN', SELLIN' RAISES HAGGLIN'. DA LEADER GAINS DA MOST, OTHERS PRESENT GAIN LESS.

DEY AFFECT FORGIN' QUALITY, LOCKPICKIN', HOLDS, WHAT MERCHANTS ACCEPT AN' WHICH RECIPES YOU CAN READ!

class_passives.title: CLASS PASSIVES
class_passives.description:
EVERY CLASS HAB SIGNATURE PASSIVES. DEY NEED NO SLOT AN' NO ACTIVATION. SOME WORK IN COMBAT, SOME ONLY OUTSIDE IT.

DEY IZ LISTED ON DA STATUS SHEET UNDER PASSIVES!

the_nine_skill_slots.title: DA NINE SKILL SLOTS
the_nine_skill_slots.description:
EACH CHARACTER TAKES NINE SKILLS INTO A FIGHT. DA SKILL MENU IZ TABBED BY ROLE, AN' DA NINE YOU PICK FILL DA BATTLE QUICK BAR.

YOU NEVER FORGET A SKILL, AN' CHANGIN' DA NINE BETWEEN FIGHTS IZ FREE!

fusing_spells.title: FUSIN' SPELLS
fusing_spells.description:
FROM DA MAGIC PAGE, TWO ABILITIES CAN BE FORGED INTO ONE. DA DOMINANT SLOT TAKES A SPELL YOU KNOW AN' SETS DAMAGE, SCOPE, HIT TYPE AN' ICON. DA RECESSIVE SLOT TAKES A SPELL OR A SKILL, AN' A SKILL MAKES DA RESULT A SKILL.

DA FUSION COSTS DA SUM OF ITS PARTS IN MP AN' AP, AN' DA SUM OF DEY TEACHIN' PRICES IN KP. DA COMPONENTS IZ FORGOTTEN ON FUSIN', AN' DA FUSION CAN BE SPLIT BACK INTO DEM AT ANY TIME!

grimoires_and_skill_books.title: GRIMOIRES AN' SKILL BOOKS
grimoires_and_skill_books.description:
A GRIMOIRE OFFERS FIVE RANDOM SPELLS AN' ONE READER PICKS ONE. DA OFFERS IZ FIXED WHEN DA BOOK IZ OPENED; SWITCHIN' READER DOES NO CHANGE DEM.

YOU CAN ONLY TAKE A SPELL YOU NO KNOW AN' CAN AFFORD WIT YA MAX MP. HIGHER PSI MAKES FORBIDDEN SPELLS MORE LIKELY.

DERE IZ SCHOOL GRIMOIRES, CATEGORY SKILL BOOKS, AN' DA FORBIDDEN GRIMOIRE, WHICH OFFERS ONLY FORBIDDEN SPELLS!

expression_seeds.title: EXPRESSION SEEDS
expression_seeds.description:
AN EXPRESSION SEED IZ USED ON ONE CHARACTER AN' UNLOCKS DEY EXPRESSION. EACH CHARACTER NEEDS A SEED OF DEY OWN.

EXPRESSION IZ OPENED FROM DA SKILLS BENCHES, PICKIN' ANY PARTY MEMBER WHO HAB IT.

A POWER CAN BE BOUND BY LIMITATIONS: NEVER ON A CHOSEN DAY, ONLY AGAINST ONE KIND OF CREATURE, ONLY BY NIGHT, ONLY AT A PRICE IN BLOOD OR GOLD. DA MORE A POWER IZ BOUND, DA LESS IT COSTS, AN' DA FURTHER IT CAN REACH BEYOND DA CHARACTER'S STATS!

equipment_hands_and_slots.title: EQUIPMENT: HANDS AN' SLOTS
equipment_hands_and_slots.description:
WEAPON SLOTS COME FROM ANATOMY: EVERY BODY PART DAT CAN HOLD A WEAPON IZ A SLOT. HANDS TAKE A WEAPON OR A SHIELD, SO TWO SHIELDS WORK AS WELL AS TWO SWORDS.

- A TWO HANDED WEAPON NEEDS TWO FREE HANDS
- A BODY WIT NO HANDS HOLDS ITS WEAPON IN DA MOUTH. SAMURAI GET A MOUTH SLOT AS WELL AS DEY HANDS
- EIGHT SLOTS AT MOST
- WIT MORE DEN TWO WEAPONS, STATS IZ AVERAGED AN' TWO RANDOM WEAPONS SWING EACH TURN
- LOSIN' A LIMB REMOVES ITS SLOT AN' DROPS WHAT IT HELD

weapon_proficiency.title: WEAPON PROFICIENCY
weapon_proficiency.description:
ANY CLASS CAN EQUIP ANY WEAPON TYPE. SKILL WIT EACH WEAPON TYPE IZ ITS OWN SPECIALIZATION. IT STARTS AT INTERMEDIATE FOR YA CLASS'S TRADITIONAL WEAPONS AN' UNTRAINED FOR DA REST.

HIGHER TIERS MAKE DA WEAPON STRONGER. UNTRAINED WIELDERS GET MUCH LESS OUT OF IT.

WINNIN' A BATTLE TRAINS EVERY EQUIPPED WEAPON TYPE!

what_a_weapon_scales_on.title: WHAT A WEAPON SCALES ON
what_a_weapon_scales_on.description: A WEAPON DOES NO ALWAYS SCALE ON STR. ITS ATTACK SKILL SETS DA ATTRIBUTE IT READS, AN' DA EQUIP SCREEN NAMES IT WHEN DA SLOT IZ SELECTED. WIT NO ATTACK SKILL IT READS STR; OTHERWISE DEX, INT, WIS, CON, PSI, OR A MIX OF TWO!

armour_and_derived_stats.title: ARMOUR AN' DERIVED STATS
armour_and_derived_stats.description:
EQUIPMENT FEEDS FOUR OUT OF COMBAT STATS BESIDES DEFENCE. CLOTHES GIVE SUBSTANCE AN' STEALTH, ROBES ARCANE, LIGHT ARMOUR STEALTH, HEAVY ARMOUR INTIMIDATION.

WEAPONS FEED DEM TOO: DAGGERS AN' BOWS STEALTH, SWORDS, HEAVY WEAPONS, AXES AN' CLAWS INTIMIDATION, STAVES ARCANE, WHIPS, PROJECTILES AN' GUNS SUBSTANCE.

DEY DECIDE HOW PEOPLE ANSWER YOU, WHAT A GUARD ASSUMES, WHICH APPROACHES IZ OPEN!

modifiers_on_gear.title: MODIFIERS ON GEAR
modifiers_on_gear.description:
A WEAPON OR ARMOUR PIECE CAN HAB ONE MODIFIER, WHICH CHANGES ITS STATS, PRICE AN' TRAITS. SHARP RAISES STR AN' PRICE ON WEAPONS, REFINED RAISES CON, WIS AN' PRICE ON ANYTINK, POISONED ADDS POISON TA A WEAPON, WORN LOWERS CON, WIS AN' PRICE ON ARMOUR.

DA MODIFIER STAYS WIT DA ITEM!

weight_and_encumbrance.title: WEIGHT AN' ENCUMBRANCE
weight_and_encumbrance.description: EVERY ITEM HAB A WEIGHT AN' DA PARTY HAB A CARRY CAPACITY. GOING OVER IT RAISES A STANDIN' NOTIFICATION DAT STAYS UP UNTIL YOU IZ BACK UNDER!

the_backpack.title: DA BACKPACK
the_backpack.description:
DA BACKPACK IZ TABBED BY CATEGORY, WIT DA WEIGHT READOUT, DA DETAIL CARD AN' DA FAVOURITES BAR.

NINE FAVOURITE SLOTS HOLD USABLE ITEMS AN' SHARE DA QUICK BAR WIT BATTLE SKILLS. ON DA MAP, 1 TA 9 USE DAT SLOT; IN DA BACKPACK, DA SAME KEYS ASSIGN DA INSPECTED ITEM. ITEMS CAN BE DRAGGED ONTO SLOTS, RIGHT CLICK CLEARS ONE.

ONLY USABLE ITEMS CAN BE FAVOURITED. WEAPONS AN' ARMOUR IZ EQUIPPED INSTEAD!

artifacts.title: ARTIFACTS
artifacts.description:
ARTIFACTS IZ PROCEDURALLY GENERATED ITEMS, WEAPONS AN' ARMOUR, EACH NAMED AN' UNIQUE.

DA ARTIFACT ANALYZER ON DA HYPERNET READS WHAT AN UNFAMILIAR ONE DOES!

containers_and_storage.title: CONTAINERS AN' STORAGE
containers_and_storage.description:
CHESTS, CUPBOARDS, CRATES AN' SACKS STORE ITEMS AN' CAN BE EMPTIED OR FILLED AT WILL.

DA PARTY'S OWN STORAGE TRAVELS WIT IT: DA EXTRADIMENSIONAL CONTAINER, AN' DA HOLDS OF DA CAMPER AN' DA CAR!

loot_and_rarity.title: LOOT AN' RARITY
loot_and_rarity.description:
RANDOM LOOT IZ SCALED AGAINST DA PARTY'S MEDIAN LEVEL, NO DA LEADER'S.

ITEMS PRINT IN DEY RARITY COLOUR EVERYWHERE: REWARD POPUP, BACKPACK, SHOP COUNTER.

ITEM DESCRIPTIONS IZ COMBINATORIAL AN' RESOLVED FROM DA WORLD SEED, SO DA SAME SWORD READS DA SAME WAY ALL THROUGH ONE WORLD AN' DIFFERENTLY IN DA NEXT!

the_five_needs.title: DA FIVE NEEDS
the_five_needs.description:
EVERYONE, YA PARTY INCLUDED, HAB FIVE NEEDS: HUNGER, SLEEP, HYGIENE, COMPANY AN' FUN.

DEY DROP AS TIME PASSES, AN' TIME PASSES AS YOU WALK, FASTER ON DA WORLD MAP. DA LEADER'S DROP FASTEST, AN' RUNNIN' DRAINS DEM ALL FASTER.

DEY SHOW AS CHIPS BESIDE EACH PARTY CARD AN' CHANGE COLOUR WHEN LOW AN' WHEN EMPTY.

AN EMPTY HUNGER DRAINS HP, AN EMPTY SLEEP DRAINS MP, AN' DA OTHERS COST YOU SOCIALLY AN' MENTALLY.

AUGMENTS CAN SLOW, STOP OR REVERSE A NEED!

hunger_and_nutrition.title: HUNGER AN' NUTRITION
hunger_and_nutrition.description:
FOOD HAB CALORIES, FAT AN' PROTEIN. A MEAL'S VALUE COMES FROM WHAT IZ IN IT, NO ITS PRICE.

YOU CAN EAT PAST FULL, BUT OVEREATIN' GIVES DA OVERFED STATE AN' BURNS FOOD FASTER.

COLD AN' HEAT BOTH MAKE YOU HUNGRY FASTER.

WIT HUNGER EMPTY YOU KEEP LOSIN' HP UNTIL YOU EAT!

sleep,_rest_and_time_awake.title: SLEEP, REST AN' TIME AWAKE
sleep,_rest_and_time_awake.description:
TWO SEPARATE TINKZ IZ TRACKED.

DA SLEEP METER IZ HOW TIRED YOU FEEL. COFFEE OR SITTIN' DOWN REFILLS IT, AN' WHEN EMPTY IT DRAINS MP.

TIME AWAKE COUNTS SINCE YA LAST REAL SLEEP, AN' ONLY A NIGHT'S REST RESETS IT. DA LONGER YOU STAY AWAKE, DA WORSE YA DREAMS GET AN' DA MORE DA PARTY'S MIND SUFFERS.

BEDS, CAMPFIRES, TENTS AN' WORLD MAP CAMPS OPEN DA REST MENU. WAITIN' AN' DA T HOTKEY ONLY MOVE DA CLOCK. CRYOGENIC SLEEP LETS YOU PICK A YEAR TA WAKE IN WHILE DA WORLD MOVES ON!

hygiene,_and_what_it_costs_you.title: HYGIENE, AN' WHAT IT COSTS YOU
hygiene,_and_what_it_costs_you.description:
REFILL HYGIENE AT A WASHROOM, SHOWER, SINK OR FOUNTAIN. LOOSE COMPANIONS GO AN' FIND ONE WHEN DEY NEED IT.

PEOPLE NOTICE HOW YOU SMELL, AN' YOU NOTICE DEM. LOW HYGIENE LOWERS WHAT OTHERS TINK OF YOU.

TRAITS DECIDE HOW MUCH IT MATTERS. FERAL IGNORES IT, ASCETIC BARELY NOTICES, STREET URCHIN, CAVE DWELLER, SURVIVALIST, FARMER AN' VETERAN MIND LIL'. PROUD, WEALTHY, BEAUTIFUL, PERFECTIONIST, NOBLE, HYPOCHONDRIAC AN' GERMAPHOBE MIND A LOT.

IT MATTERS EVEN MORE WHEN COURTIN'!

company.title: COMPANY
company.description:
COMPANY DRAINS LIKE ANY OTHER NEED AN' IZ REFILLED BY TALKIN', TA TOWNSPEOPLE OR BETWEEN TWO OF YA OWN.

A LOOSE MEMBER STARVED OF COMPANY WALKS UP TA SOMEONE AN' STARTS A CONVERSATION UNPROMPTED. DAT CONVERSATION MOVES WHAT DA OTHER PERSON THINKS OF DEM, AN' HYGIENE COUNTS IN IT.

GAININ' STANDIN' WIT SOMEONE FEEDS DA SOCIAL METER OF WHOEVER GAINED IT!

fun.title: FUN
fun.description:
FUN IZ REFILLED BY PLAYIN': ARCADE CABINETS, PIANOS, POOL TABLES, CARD GAMES, AN' JOKES DAT LAND IN CONVERSATION. A JOKE DAT LANDS ALSO RAISES DA LISTENER'S FUN FOR DA REST OF DA DAY.

A PARTY WIT FUN ON DA FLOOR COMPLAINS 'BOUT IT IN BANTER!

cravings_and_withdrawal.title: CRAVINGS AN' WITHDRAWAL
cravings_and_withdrawal.description:
FIVE TRAITS IZ ADDICTIONS: ALCOHOL, CAFFEINE, NICOTINE, NARCOTICS AN' GAMBLIN'. ONLY A MEMBER WIT ONE HAB A CRAVIN' METER.

DA CRAVIN' CLIMBS WHILE UNFED AN' DROPS WHEN YOU FEED IT. A FULL METER MEANS WITHDRAWAL, AN' ONE DOSE IZ NO ENOUGH TA END IT.

CRAVINGS CLIMB SLOWER WHILE ASLEEP!

limbs_and_organs.title: LIMBS AN' ORGANS
limbs_and_organs.description:
EVERY CHARACTER AN' MONSTER HAB INDIVIDUAL LIMBS AN' ORGANS, EACH WIT ITS OWN HEALTH.

DAMAGE SPREADS ACROSS PARTS. A PART AT 0 IZ DESTROYED AN' CHANGES WHAT DA BODY CAN DO: A LOST HAND LOSES ITS WEAPON SLOT, A BODY WIT NO HANDS HOLDS A WEAPON IN ITS MOUTH, DAMAGED LEGS COST MOVEMENT AN' EVASION. DAMAGED OR DESTROYED PARTS NO CAN GRAPPLE OR BE GRAPPLED.

VITAL ORGANS CAN ONLY BE HIT BY AIMIN' AT DEM, AN' A BLOW TA ONE IZ ONLY FATAL ONCE ITS OWNER IZ BADLY HURT.

PARTS NEVER HEAL ON DEY OWN. TREAT DEM AT A CLINIC, RESTORE DEM WIT MAGIC, OR REPLACE DEM WIT A PROSTHETIC. IN BLOOD AN' OIL A SLASHIN' OR PIERCIN' BLOW CAN CUT A PART OFF, AUGMENT INCLUDED.

DA STATUS SHEET'S ANATOMY SECTION SHOWS DA BODY PART BY PART!

biologics.title: BIOLOGICS
biologics.description:
BIOLOGICS IZ DA DEEP READOUT: VITAL SIGNS, HORMONES, BLOOD CHEMISTRY, BRAIN REGIONS AN' DEY ACTIVITY, BLOOD TYPE, REPRODUCTIVE CYCLE, AN' EVERY CONDITION ACTIN' ON DA BODY.

HEART RATE REACTS TA WHAT IZ HAPPENIN' TA YOU, HORMONES TA SLEEP, INJURY AN' PREGNANCY. BLOOD TYPE IZ SET ONCE AN' NEVER CHANGES.

DA LEY VEIN SYSTEM LINKS IT TA LIMB DAMAGE: BLOCKAGES SHOW UP HERE WHEN DA BODY HAB BIN HURT!

diseases.title: DISEASES
diseases.description:
HUNDREDS OF DISEASES EXIST. EACH SPREADS IN ITS OWN WAYS (AIRBORNE, SALIVA, BITE, CONTACT, SEXUAL AN' OTHERS), CHANGES STATS WHILE YOU HAB IT, AN' OFTEN SHOWS SYMPTOMS ONLY AFTER A WHILE. DAT DELAY IZ DA WINDOW PERIOD.

DISEASES CAN PASS BETWEEN PARTY MEMBERS AN' BETWEEN YOU AN' ANYONE YOU TALK TA THROUGH EMPATHIZE. SEXUAL DISEASES NO SPREAD BY PROXIMITY.

EVERY NPC HAB A MEDICAL HISTORY, SHOWN ON DA HEALTH TAB OF DEY PANEL.

DIAGNOSE CHECKS DA WHOLE PARTY AN' NAMES EVERY ILLNESS, EVEN ONES STILL IN DA WINDOW PERIOD!

epidemics.title: EPIDEMICS
epidemics.description:
EPIDEMICS SPREAD ACROSS DA CONTINENT WHETHER YOU WATCH OR NO. DEY TRAVEL BETWEEN TOWNS, AN' TOWNS FIGHT BACK DA LONGER DEY IZ INFECTED.

AN OUTBREAK IZ A REAL DISEASE DAT CAN KILL. A HYSTERIA IZ NO: DANCIN' FEVER, PANICS, PHANTOM GASSERS. YOU CATCH A HYSTERIA BY SEEIN' IT AN' SPREAD IT BY TALKIN' 'BOUT IT.

EVERY WORLD STARTS WIT THREE RUNNIN': ONE HYSTERIA, ONE ORDINARY OUTBREAK, ONE RARE AN' DEADLY.

ANYONE IN AN INFECTED TOWN IZ EXPOSED, YOU INCLUDED. OUTBREAKS AFFECT MOOD, JOBS, SHOPS, NEEDS, GOSSIP AN' DA NEWS. TRACK DEM IN DA EURODEMICS APP!

clinics,_prosthetics_and_field_surgery.title: CLINICS, PROSTHETICS AN' FIELD SURGERY
clinics,_prosthetics_and_field_surgery.description:
A CLINIC CAN INSTALL, REMOVE OR REPLACE A BODY PART, OR FIT AN IMPLANT. BIGGER PARTS COST MORE TA INSTALL. VITAL PARTS NO CAN BE REMOVED.

FIELD SURGERY WORKS ON DA ROAD AN' IZ FREE: PICK A PATIENT AN' A SURGEON. YOU CAN ONLY FIT PARTS YOU CARRY, AN' YOU CAN REMOVE AN AUGMENT BUT NO INSTALL ONE.

EVERY OPERATION CAN FAIL, AN' DA ODDS IZ SHOWN FIRST. A BETTER SURGERY SPECIALIZATION HELPS, A ROOF HELPS, BAD WEATHER AN' DA OPEN AIR HURT, AN' OPERATIN' ON YOURSELF IZ HARDER.

A FAILURE WOUNDS DA PATIENT ELSEWHERE. VITAL ORGANS IZ ONLY AT RISK IN BLOOD AN' OIL!

augments.title: AUGMENTS
augments.description:
DA AUGMENTS REGISTER HAB TWO LISTS. FITTED IZ EVERY AUGMENT DA PARTY WEARS, WIT ITS WEARER AN' SOCKET. CATALOGUE IZ EVERYTINK DAT EXISTS, READABLE BEFORE PAYIN' TA HAB IT GRAFTED.

DA DOSSIER GIVES DA COST, DA BONUS, DA SKILL IT TEACHES, AN' EVERY SOCKET DAT ACCEPTS IT, CREATURE SOCKETS INCLUDED.

AUGMENTS IZ ALSO HOW DA NEEDS SYSTEM IZ BENT: DA RIGHT HARDWARE SLOWS A METER, STOPS IT, OR REVERSES IT!

weather,_temperature_and_the_body.title: WEATHER, TEMPERATURE AN' DA BODY
weather,_temperature_and_the_body.description:
TEMPERATURE IZ SHOWN ON DA TRAVEL CARD AN' AFFECTS DA BODY. COLD AN' HEAT BOTH MAKE HUNGER DROP FASTER.

BAD WEATHER MAKES FIELD SURGERY RISKIER, AN' CHANGES WHAT PEOPLE DO AN' WHERE DEY GO!

how_a_fight_starts.title: HOW A FIGHT STARTS
how_a_fight_starts.description:
DERE IZ NO RANDOM ENCOUNTERS. EVERY MONSTER STANDS ON DA MAP WIT ITS LEVEL OVER ITS HEAD, AN' YOU FIGHT IT BY WALKIN' INTO IT.

TURNS IZ INDIVIDUAL: EACH BATTLER ACTS WHEN ITS OWN TURN COMES UP, IN AGILITY ORDER, AN' YA ACTION RESOLVES AS SOON AS YOU CHOOSE IT.

BAD 'UNS KEEP DEY DAMAGE BETWEEN FIGHTS. A WOUNDED MONSTER YOU RAN FROM IZ STILL WOUNDED WHEN YOU COME BACK, AN' CORPSES STAY ON DA MAP.

FLEEIN' ALWAYS WORKS!

the_battle_commands.title: DA BATTLE COMMANDS
the_battle_commands.description:
DA COMMAND MENU HOLDS ATTACK, GUARD, SKILLS, MAGIC, ITEM, ESCAPE, RELOAD WHEN A FIREARM IZ EMPTY, AN' FOUR OF ITS OWN:

- CHECK: OPENS DA BAD 'UN'S BODY, LIMB BY LIMB, WIT DA CHANCE OF HITTIN' EACH
- TARGET: AIMS YA NEXT BLOW AT ONE PART
- WRESTLE: TAKES HOLD OF DA BAD 'UN
- TALK: ANOTHER WAY TA END A FIGHT

WRESTLE AN' TALK IZ COMMANDS, NO SKILLS. DEY TAKE NO LOADOUT SLOT, NO CAN BE FORGOTTEN, AN' COME FROM DA BODY RATHER DEN DA CLASS.

MOUSE: LEFT CLICK AN BAD 'UN TA RUN DA SELECTED COMMAND ON IT, RIGHT CLICK CYCLES, WHEEL SCROLLS, 1 TA 5 FIRE!

mp_and_ap.title: MP AN' AP
mp_and_ap.description:
TWO RESOURCES. MP IZ MAGIC: SPELLS COST IT, IT REFILLS SLOWLY, AN' MOST RITES AN' SUMMONS IZ KEPT UP WIT IT.

AP IZ STAMINA, USED BY BATTLE SKILLS AN' BY RUNNIN' ON DA MAP. WALKIN' REFILLS IT SLOWLY, STANDIN' STILL FASTER.

SPELLS IZ WRITTEN IN CamelCase AN' COST MP. SKILLS IZ WRITTEN IN PLAIN WORDS AN' COST AP!

hitting_what_you_aim_at.title: HITTIN' WHAT YOU AIM AT
hitting_what_you_aim_at.description:
MONSTERS HAB LIMBS AN' ORGANS JUST LIKE DA PARTY. CHECK LISTS EVERY PART WIT ITS CONDITION AN' YA CHANCE TA HIT IT, AN' TARGET AIMS YA NEXT BLOW AT ONE. BIGGER PARTS IZ EASIER TA HIT, AN' YA WEAPON AN' STATS MATTER.

DESTROYIN' A LIMB REMOVES WHAT IT DOES: A BROKEN LEG SLOWS, A RUINED WING STOPS FLIGHT, NO HANDS MEANS NO WEAPON. VITAL ORGANS CAN ONLY BE HIT BY TARGETIN' DEM.

PART DAMAGE LASTS DA WHOLE FIGHT, AN' A FINISHIN' BLOW CAN CUT DA PART OFF!

wrestling.title: WRESTLIN'
wrestling.description:
WRESTLE IZ OPEN TA ANY BODY WIT ONE LIMB WHOLE ENOUGH TA GRIP. IT COSTS NUTTIN' AN' IZ NEVER LEARNED.

IT REPLACES DA COMMAND MENU WIT DA GRAPPLE PLAN: WHICH OF YA LIMBS TAKES DA HOLD, WHICH OF DEY IT IZ TAKEN ON, AN' WHICH HOLD. EACH ROW SHOWS DA ODDS. A PART AT 0, DAMAGED OR SEVERED CAN NEITHER GRAB NOR BE GRABBED, ON EITHER SIDE.

- GRAPPLE, STR AGAINST DEX: TAKES HOLD. EVERYTINK ELSE NEEDS ONE FIRST
- STRIKE, STR AGAINST DEX: NEEDS NO HOLD, CAN CONCUSS ON DA HEAD
- JOINT LOCK, DEX AGAINST STR: PINS, OFTEN BREAKS DA GUARD
- WRENCH, STR AGAINST CON: HEAVY DAMAGE, CAN CAUSE BLEEDIN'
- SLAM, CON AGAINST DEX: GUARD BROKEN, WINDED, CHANCE TA STUN
- CHOKE, CON AGAINST CON, HEAD ONLY: GUARD BROKEN, VITALS EXPOSED
- RIP, STR AGAINST CON: LOW ODDS, ENORMOUS DAMAGE, CAN TEAR DA LIMB OFF

EVERYTINK SCALES WIT DA WRESTLIN' SPECIALIZATION. ANY TRAINED MARTIAL ART ADDS ITS OWN FINISHERS WITOUT DEM BEING LEARNED AS SKILLS!

talking_to_monsters.title: TALKIN' TA MONSTERS
talking_to_monsters.description:
MONSTERS DAT CAN UNDERSTAND YOU CAN BE TALKED TA. TALK OPENS A PANEL SHOWIN' DA ODDS OF EACH OPTION.

EACH BAD 'UN HAB A MOOD TOWARDS YOU. ITS SPECIES SHAPES IT, HURTIN' IT LOWERS IT, AN' YA PSI AGAINST ITS OWN HELPS.

- CHAT BUILDS RAPPORT
- SURRENDER ASKS IT TA LEAVE DA FIGHT
- JOIN DA PARTY NEEDS A FREE SLOT AN' A FRIENDLY BAD 'UN
- FOLLOW YOU, OR BE ADOPTED AS A PET, NEEDS A FRIENDLY BAD 'UN
- INSULT ALWAYS WORKS AN' MAKES IT ANGRIER
- THROW A STONE, OR PET IT

SOME CREATURES, PETRODEMONS ABOVE ALL, REFUSE EVERY APPROACH.

ONE TALKED INTO JOININ' BECOMES A PARTY MEMBER. A PET OR FOLLOWER CAN BE TRAINED INTO A MEMBER LATER!

enemy_levels_and_where_they_live.title: BAD 'UN LEVELS AN' WHERE DEY LIVE
enemy_levels_and_where_they_live.description:
DA BAD 'UN SPAWN OPTION SETS HOW BAD 'UN LEVELS IZ CHOSEN.

- BALANCED: BAD 'UNS IZ A BIT ABOVE YA PARTY'S LEVEL, WIT DA ODD BOSS ABOVE DAT
- DISTANCE FROM SPAWN (DEFAULT): BAD 'UNS GET STRONGER DA FARTHER YOU IZ FROM WHERE YOU STARTED
- CHAOS: ANY LEVEL, REROLLED EVERY TIME YOU ENTER A MAP

EACH SQUARE HAB CREATURES DAT FIT ITS BIOME. NO CREATURE IZ EXCLUSIVE TA A COUNTRY; NATIONS ONLY CHANGE HOW COMMON EACH ONE IZ.

DA CALENDAR MATTERS TOO: BAD 'UNS GET STRONGER AS DA YEARS GO BY!

how_monsters_behave.title: HOW MONSTERS BEHAVE
how_monsters_behave.description:
EACH ROAMIN' MONSTER HAB A MOVEMENT PERSONALITY DAT SETS WHAT IT DOES WHILE IDLE, HOW IT NOTICES YOU (SIGHT RANGE, FACIN' CONE, LINE OF SIGHT) AN' WHAT IT DOES ONCE IT HAB.

FIXED, RANDOM, APPROACH, FLEEIN', SKITTISH, GRAZER, SENTRY, GUARD, PATROL, TERRITORIAL, AMBUSHER, LURKER, MIMIC, SWOOPER, STALKER, HUNTER, CHARGER, PACK, ERRATIC, DRIFTER, ORBITER, SCAVENGER, COWARD.

A GRAZER NEVER NOTICES YOU. A SENTRY HAB A CONE AN' CAN BE WALKED AROUND. AN AMBUSHER IZ NO WHERE IT APPEARS TA BE. A PACK DOES NO FIGHT ALONE!

danger_warnings_and_surviving_a_blow.title: DANGER WARNINGS AN' SURVIVIN' A BLOW
danger_warnings_and_surviving_a_blow.description:
BEFORE A FIGHT DA PARTY'S MEDIAN LEVEL IZ COMPARED WIT DA BAD 'UN, AN' A WARNIN' APPEARS WHEN IT IZ OUT OF RANGE. BAD 'UN LEVELS IZ DRAWN OVER DEY HEADS ON DA MAP.

INSIDE A FIGHT EACH CHARACTER HAB ONE HEALTH PROTECTION CHARGE: DA FIRST BLOW DAT WOULD KILL DEM LEAVES DEM AT 1 HP. IT COMES BACK NEXT BATTLE. BLOOD AN' OIL REMOVES IT!

difficulty_and_combat_modes.title: DIFFICULTY AN' COMBAT MODES
difficulty_and_combat_modes.description:
SEVERAL FIDDLY BITS CHANGE WHAT COMBAT IZ, MOST CHOSEN AT CHARACTER CREATION.

- PEACEFUL: MONSTERS ACT ONLY ONCE HURT, PER BAD 'UN. AN UNPROVOKED ONE SKIPS ITS TURN, ROAMIN' MONSTERS WANDER INSTEAD OF CHASIN', AN' A WIPE RESPAWNS YOU WIT NOBODY DEAD
- ORDINARY: DEATH LEAVES A GRAVESTONE AN' DA RUN CONTINUES
- HARDCORE AN' BLOOD AN' OIL: DEATH IZ A GAME OVER AN' DA CHARACTER IZ REMOVED. BLOOD AN' OIL ALSO DROPS DA HEALTH PROTECTION CHARGE AN' LETS A SLASHIN' BLOW TAKE A PART OFF DA BODY
- CARD COMBAT: REPLACES DA COMMAND MENU
- MAP BATTLE: FIGHTS ON DA LIVE MAP

map_battle_mode.title: MAP BATTLE MODE
map_battle_mode.description:
AN EXPERIMENTAL OPTION DAT FIGHTS EVERY BATTLE ON DA MAP YOU IZ ON, WIT NO SEPARATE BATTLE SCREEN.

EVERYONE FIGHTS FROM WHERE DEY STAND. NEARBY MONSTERS CAN JOIN IN, AN' TOWNSPEOPLE NEARBY MAY HELP YOU IF DEY LIKE DA PARTY OR IZ BRAVE.

MOVE REPOSITIONS DA ACTIN' BATTLER; FASTER BATTLERS MOVE FARTHER. WEAPONS HAB REACH: MELEE IZ ADJACENT, SPEARS, WHIPS, STAVES AN' FLAILS REACH FARTHER, BOWS, GUNS AN' THROWN WEAPONS FARTHER STILL, AN' NEED LINE OF SIGHT. WATER MEANS SWIMMIN', WHICH COSTS MORE MOVEMENT.

TURN ORDER: PARTY AN' BAD 'UNS BY AGILITY, DEN TOWNSPEOPLE, DEN EVERYTINK ELSE ON DA MAP MOVES ONE STEP!

card_combat.title: CARD COMBAT
card_combat.description:
ANOTHER WAY TA FIGHT, CHOSEN AT CHARACTER CREATION OR TURNED ON IN DA EXPERIMENTAL FIDDLY BITS. A FIGHT ALREADY RUNNIN' KEEPS ITS MODE; DA CHANGE APPLIES FROM DA NEXT ONE.

EACH MEMBER HAB DEY OWN DECK, HAND AN' ENERGY, BUILT FROM DEY CLASS SKILLS. PLAYIN' A CARD IZ DAT MEMBER'S WHOLE TURN.

ENERGY REPLACES MP AN' AP. CARDS COST ENERGY BASED ON DA SKILL, AN' A PLAIN ATTACK IZ CHEAPEST. YOU GAIN ENERGY EACH TURN, AN' PASSIN' GIVES EXTRA ENERGY AN' A CARD.

CHEAP CARDS COME UP MOST OFTEN, AN' YA OPENIN' HAND ALWAYS HAB SOMETINK YOU CAN PLAY!

summons.title: SUMMONS
summons.description:
A SUMMON IZ A TEMPORARY FOURTH MEMBER. IN BATTLE IT LASTS FOR DAT FIGHT ONLY, AN' LEAVES WHEN DA FIGHT ENDS OR WHEN YOU STOP PAYIN' FOR IT.

IT CAN BE A CREATURE, A PERSON DA PARTY HAB MARKED, YA PET, A REFLECTION OF DA SUMMONER, OR DA GHOST OF A LOST COMPANION.

ITS STRENGTH MATCHES YA PARTY AN' DA BAD 'UNS ON DA FIELD. A FAMILIAR IZ WEAKER DEN A PARTY MEMBER, A TITAN A BIT STRONGER.

EACH KIND HAB AN UPKEEP: HP, MP, AP, EUROS, SOUL, OIL, OR A FIXED NUMBER OF TURNS. WHEN YOU NO CAN PAY, IT LEAVES, AN' A SUMMONER WHO NO CAN PAY IN BLOOD DROPS TA 1 HP.

DA FAMILIAR BELONGS TA ONE CHARACTER, AN' DEY CLASS DECIDES WHICH CREATURE ANSWERS. CHANGIN' CLASS CHANGES DA FAMILIAR.

WHILE A SUMMON IZ OUT, DAMAGE DA PARTY DEALS FILLS A HYPER BAR. WHEN FULL, DA SUMMON UNLEASHES ITS ULTIMATE.

SUMMONS IZ ALWAYS COMPUTER CONTROLLED AN' NO GET DA 1 HP PROTECTION.

OUTSIDE BATTLE DA SAME RITES WORK, AN' DA SUMMON WALKS WIT YOU FOR AS LONG AS YOU PAY MP!

the_arena.title: DA ARENA
the_arena.description:
DA ARENA OFFERS FIGHTS FOR DEY OWN SAKE, IN TWO FORMS: A GAUNTLET, A RUN OF FIGHTS IN A CHOSEN LEVEL BRACKET, AN' A BIOME TRIAL, A RUN AGAINST DA FAUNA OF A CHOSEN BIOME.

DA PARTY IZ RESCALED TA DA BRACKET, AN' A RANDOM ROSTER CAN BE FIELDED INSTEAD OF YA OWN.

CONSECUTIVE WINS BUILD A STREAK, WIT GROWIN' REWARDS OF MONEY AN' ITEMS!

bullet_hell_sequences.title: BULLET HELL SEQUENCES
bullet_hell_sequences.description:
SOME FIGHTS BREAK INTO A BULLET HELL SEQUENCE: YOU STEER A LIL' CRAFT, DODGE DA BAD 'UN'S PATTERN AN' SHOOT BACK.

DAMAGE TAKEN AN' DEALT DERE COUNTS IN DA FIGHT.

SOME BAD 'UN ULTIMATES MUST BE DODGED DIS WAY BEFORE DEY LAND: DA MORE SHOTS YOU TAKE, DA HARDER DA BLOW. BULLET TIME SLOWS DA BAD 'UN FIRE. FIGHTS ON DA MAP SKIP DA DODGE AN' DA BLOW LANDS AS USUAL!

spirit_battlers.title: SPIRIT BATTLERS
spirit_battlers.description:
DEFEATED BAD 'UNS JOIN A SPIRIT ROSTER. ONE CAN BE FIELDED IN PLACE OF AN ORDINARY BATTLER, AT A COST DAT SCALES WIT WHAT IT WAZ.

DA FEATURE HAB ITS OWN SWITCH; WIT IT OFF, BATTLES IZ ORDINARY!

mimicry.title: MIMICRY
mimicry.description:
SIX MIMIC SKILLS COPY OTHER BODIES:

- PARTIAL MIMICRY: DA BAD 'UN'S FACE AN' MAP SPRITE, NUMBERS UNCHANGED
- FULL MIMICRY: STATS, HP, MP, AP, SKILLS, BODY AN' LOOKS
- MIRROR: RE-EXECUTES DA BAD 'UN'S LAST SKILL AGAINST IT
- COPY ALLY: A COMPANION'S NAME, CLASS, SKILLS, SPRITE AN' BODY
- RANDOM: FULL MIMICRY OF A CREATURE DRAWN AT RANDOM
- MUTATION: MERGES TWO RANDOM ARCHETYPES INTO YA OWN BODY PARTS

ALL SIX NEED EXACTLY ONE BAD 'UN ON DA FIELD. COPYIN' A BODY COPIES ITS LIMBS, WHICH CHANGES WHAT YOU CAN HOLD AN' WHERE YOU CAN BE HURT!

throwing_things.title: THROWIN' TINKZ
throwing_things.description:
ITEMS, WEAPONS AN' ARMOUR CAN BE THROWN A SHORT DISTANCE IN ANY DIRECTION. HEAVY TINKZ NO GO FAR BUT LAND HARD.

A THROWN ITEM STAYS WHERE IT LANDS AN' ANYONE CAN PICK IT UP!

corpses,_rewards_and_cooldowns.title: CORPSES, REWARDS AN' COOLDOWNS
corpses,_rewards_and_cooldowns.description:
AFTER A FIGHT DA REWARD POPUP NAMES EVERYTINK AT ONCE: ITEMS IN DEY RARITY COLOURS, MONEY, EXPERIENCE AN' KNOWLEDGE, DA LAST SCALED BY BAD 'UN LEVEL AGAINST DA PARTY MEDIAN.

DA DEAD LEAVE CORPSES ON DA MAP, AN' BAD 'UN EVENTS IZ REMOVED OR PUT BEHIND A COOLDOWN RATHER DEN RESPAWNIN' AT ONCE.

EVERY CREATURE MET IZ WRITTEN INTO DA BESTIARY!

elements_how_they_work.title: ELEMENTS: HOW DEY WORK
elements_how_they_work.description:
NINE DAMAGE TYPES: PHYSICAL, FIRE, ICE, THUNDER, WATER, PETRO, WIND, SACRED, CURSED.

EVERY CREATURE ANSWERS EACH WIT A RATE. ABOVE 100% IZ A WEAKNESS, BELOW IZ RESISTANCE, 0% IZ IMMUNITY, AN' A NEGATIVE RATE ABSORBS DA ELEMENT AN' HEALS FROM IT.

DA BATTLE HUD SHOWS WHAT YOU HAB DISCOVERED 'BOUT DA BAD 'UN IN FRONT OF YOU, AN' DA BESTIARY KEEPS IT.

STATES INTERACT: WET RAISES LIGHTNING DAMAGE, OILY RAISES FIRE DAMAGE, STATIC ABSORBS LIGHTNING. A CLASS LEANS TOWARD AN ELEMENT, AN' A WEAPON OR MODIFIER CAN HAB ONE!

element_physical.title: ELEMENT: PHYSICAL
element_physical.description:
EDGES, POINTS, WEIGHT AN' FISTS. MOST WEAPONS DEAL IT AN' MOST ARMOUR IZ BUILT TA STOP IT.

PHYSICAL DAMAGE SEVERS LIMBS, BREAKS GUARDS AN' LANDS HOLDS. HEAVY ARMOUR RESISTS IT AN' FEEDS INTIMIDATION, LIGHT ARMOUR TRADES DAT FOR STEALTH.

SPIRITS, OOZES AN' GASES RESIST IT!

element_fire.title: ELEMENT: FIRE
element_fire.description:
APPLIES BURNED, WHICH KEEPS DEALIN' DAMAGE AFTER DA BLOW.

RAISED AGAINST ANYTINK OILY, DRY OR WOODEN. RESISTED BY DA WET AN' DA COLD BLOODED, ABSORBED BY TINKZ DAT LIVE IN FIRE!

element_ice.title: ELEMENT: ICE
element_ice.description:
APPLIES COLD, AN' FREEZE AT STRENGTH, WHICH STOPS A BODY ACTIN'.

RAISED AGAINST WET TARGETS. USED ON A BURNIN' TARGET IT REMOVES DA BURN!

element_thunder.title: ELEMENT: THUNDER
element_thunder.description:
APPLIES STATIC, AN' PARALYSIS AT STRENGTH.

DEVASTATIN' AGAINST A WET TARGET. ABSORBED BY ANYTINK ALREADY STATIC, WHICH HEALS IT INSTEAD.

MACHINES AN' CONSTRUCTS USUALLY RESIST IT!

element_water.title: ELEMENT: WATER
element_water.description:
APPLIES WET, WHICH RAISES LIGHTNING DAMAGE, LOWERS FIRE DAMAGE AN' IZ READ BY SEVERAL STATES.

ITS OWN DAMAGE IZ LOW!

element_petro.title: ELEMENT: PETRO
element_petro.description:
OIL AN' WHAT COMES OUT OF DA GROUND WIT IT.

PETRO BELONGS TA DA PETRODEMONS, WHICH NO CAN BE TALKED TA, PETTED OR REASONED WIT, AN' WHICH DROP BARRELS RATHER DEN COINS. OIL WORKS AS A CURRENCY: IT PRICES DA POST BETWEEN WORLDS, IT HOLDS DA PETRODEMON SUMMON ON DA FIELD, AN' DA MARKET TRADES IT.

PETRO DAMAGE LEAVES DA TARGET FLAMMABLE!

element_wind.title: ELEMENT: WIND
element_wind.description:
AIR, PRESSURE AN' CUTTIN' MOTION. IT UNBALANCES AN' DISPLACES.

FLYIN' CREATURES DEAL IT AN' RESIST IT. IT IZ WEAKEST AGAINST ROOTED OR HEAVY TARGETS!

element_sacred.title: ELEMENT: SACRED
element_sacred.description:
STRONG AGAINST DA UNDEAD AN' DA CURSED. IT IZ DA ONE DAMAGE TYPE DAT HEALS ITS TARGET WHEN DAT TARGET IZ ON DA RIGHT SIDE OF DA LINE.

SACRED WORKINGS USUALLY ADD PROTECTION AN' PURGIN' TA DA DAMAGE, AN' SEVERAL SIT DEEP IN EXPENSIVE SCHOOLS!

element_cursed.title: ELEMENT: CURSED
element_cursed.description:
ROT, RUIN AN' DRAININ'. DEALT BY DA UNDEAD, COUNTERED BY SACRED.

CURSED SPELLS OFTEN COST MORE DEN MP, AN' DA STRONGEST IZ FORBIDDEN, WHICH MAKES DEM REAL EXPENSIVE TA LEARN.

STRONG AGAINST DA LIVIN'. IT HEALS DA UNDEAD!

the_world_map.title: DA WORLD MAP
the_world_map.description:
DA WORLD MAP IZ ONE MAP OF EUROPE, EACH TILE A WHOLE REGION. WALKIN' ONE COSTS TEN MINUTES OF GAME TIME, TWO IN A VEHICLE.

M CYCLES DA DISPLAY: HIDDEN, CORNER MINIMAP, FULLSCREEN. IN FULLSCREEN, DRAG TA PAN, WHEEL OR Q AN' E TA ZOOM.

STEPPIN' ONTO A TILE OFFERS TA KEEP GOING OR TA VISIT DA SQUARE, WHICH BUILDS ITS LOCAL MAP. T SWITCHES BETWEEN DA WORLD MAP AN' DA LAST LOCAL MAP.

ON DA WORLD MAP, LOOSE COMPANIONS STAY WITHIN TWO TILES OF DA LEADER, AN' SQUARES MARKED "???" IZ ADVENTURES!

procedural_maps.title: PROCEDURAL MAPS
procedural_maps.description:
ALMOST EVERY MAP IZ GENERATED. A WORLD MAP SQUARE BECOMES A MAP WHEN YOU ENTER IT, AN' IT IZ DA SAME MAP EVERY TIME YOU RETURN.

DA BIOME SETS DA TERRAIN AN' WHAT GROWS DERE. ROADS, RIVERS AN' COASTLINES LINE UP WIT DA NEIGHBOURIN' SQUARES, AN' HAND MADE PIECES IZ MIXED IN.

WALKIN' OFF DA EDGE TAKES YOU TA DA NEXT SQUARE!

biomes.title: BIOMES
biomes.description:
DA BIOME OF A SQUARE SETS ITS TILESET, TERRAIN FEATURES, FAUNA, MUSIC, WEATHER AN' FORAGEABLES.

SOME IZ SPECIAL VARIANTS, ROLLED RATHER DEN FIXED: SPIRIT WOODS, CRYSTAL FIELDS. CERTAIN CREATURES LIVE ONLY DERE, AN' A SPECIAL BIOME ALWAYS PLACES AT LEAST ONE OF DEM, WHATEVER DA SPAWN MODE OR DA CALENDAR.

ROOFED BIOMES, CELLARS, TEMPLE INTERIORS, CAVE DENS AN' DUNGEONS, IZ ENTERED THROUGH A STRUCTURE ENTRANCE INSTEAD OF WALKED INTO!

structures_under_the_map.title: STRUCTURES UNDER DA MAP
structures_under_the_map.description:
ENTRANCES ON PROCEDURAL MAPS IZ WALKED INTO, NO PRESSED. WHAT LIES BEHIND IZ ROLLED FROM DA WORLD SEED, DA SQUARE AN' DA TILE, SO ONE STAIRWAY ALWAYS LEADS TA DA SAME PLACE.

- STAIRS DOWN: ANY STRUCTURE. CELLAR, DUNGEON, CRYPT, CATACOMBS, ME, CISTERN, WARREN, OUBLIETTE, LIBRARY, FORGE, BUNKER, LABORATORY, SHRINE, TUNNEL, GROTTO, LAVA TUBE, BARROW, STATION, SALT WORKS, CAVE DEN, TEMPLE
- STAIRS UP: TINKZ BUILT ABOVE GROUND AN' SINCE BURIED
- CAVE: DENS, FROZEN CAVES, CRYSTAL CAVES, FUNGAL CAVES, LAVA TUBES, SEA GROTTOES
- GRATE: A SEWER, ONLY IN TOWNS DAT DECLARE ONE UNDERNEATH
- HATCH: A HOLY PATRON BUNKER, FULL OF MONEY AN' RARE WEAPONS

DA SURFACE LIMITS DA FIDDLY BITS: ICE FIELDS HOLD FROZEN CAVES, A GRAVEYARD HOLDS CATACOMBS!

houses,_inns_and_shops.title: HOUSES, INNS AN' SHOPS
houses,_inns_and_shops.description:
DOORS ON GENERATED MAPS LEAD TA HOUSES, INNS, SHOPS AN' TOWER BLOCKS. DA SAME DOOR ALWAYS LEADS TA DA SAME PLACE.

BUILDINGS CAN HAB SEVERAL FLOORS. SHOPS AN' INNS SHOW DEY NAME OVER DA DOOR.

DOORS OPEN WHEN YOU WALK INTO DEM, UNLESS DEY IZ LOCKED!

working_the_terrain.title: WORKIN' DA TERRAIN
working_the_terrain.description:
FACE A TERRAIN FEATURE AN' PRESS DA ACTION BUTTON TA WORK IT. FELL TREES WIT AN AXE, ME ROCKS WIT A WAR PICK, A HEAVY WEAPON OR A PICKAXE, PICK PLANTS BY HAND. ANYTINK CAN BE DISMANTLED.

YOU GET CRAFTIN' MATERIALS. MININ' SOMETIMES GIVES AN INGOT.

FORAGIN' ALWAYS GIVES PLANT MATTER AN' SOMETIMES SOMETINK TA EAT, DEPENDIN' ON DA REGION. TRAININ' FORAGIN' IMPROVES YA FINDS.

ALIEN PLANETS HAB NUTTIN' TA FORAGE. FOOD DERE COMES FROM BUTCHERIN' WILDLIFE.

FELLED TREES AN' WORKED FEATURES STAY GONE!

the_dungeon_and_the_tower.title: DA DUNGEON AN' DA TOWER
the_dungeon_and_the_tower.description:
ONE GREAT DUNGEON, ITS LAYOUT ROLLED WHEN DA WORLD IZ CREATED.

ABOVE GROUND IT RUNS IN TEN LEVELS, A TA J, EACH OF NINE ORDINARY FLOORS AN' ONE ELEVATOR FLOOR. DA ELEVATOR AN' DA FLOOR LIST JUMP TA ANY FLOOR ALREADY REACHED; UNSEEN FLOORS SHOW AS QUESTION MARKS.

BELOW GROUND IZ DA LOWER TOWER, NINETY TWO GENERATED FLOORS, EACH ONE OF DA STRUCTURES FROM DA PROCEDURAL CATALOGUE. STAIRS READ DA OTHER WAY DOWN DERE: DEEPER IZ A SMALLER NUMBER!

puzzles.title: PUZZLES
puzzles.description:
MAPS CAN HAB PUZZLES:

- SOKOBAN BLOCKS, PITS DAT SWALLOW DEM, GOAL TILES, RESET AN' UNDO SHRINES
- PRESSURE PLATES, TIMED PLATES DAT MUST BE HELD, LEVERS, GATES WIRED WIT AN' / OR LOGIC
- ICE FLOORS, ARROW TILES, CONVEYORS
- CRYSTAL SWITCHES DAT FLIP SETS OF BLOCKS BETWEEN SOLID AN' OPEN
- TORCHES TA LIGHT, SOMETIMES TIMED, SOMETIMES SPREADIN' FIRE
- COLOUR TILES, LIGHTS OUT GRIDS, COLOURED DOORS, COMBINATION LOCKS
- WARP PADS, CRACKABLE WALLS, LIGHT BEAMS TA REDIRECT, CLONES DAT COPY YA MOVES, MAGNETIC OBJECTS, COUNTERWEIGHTS, FLOODABLE ROOMS

fog_of_war.title: FOG OF WAR
fog_of_war.description:
SOME MAPS IZ COVERED IN FOG DAT CLEARS AS YOU WALK. VISION IZ A CONE: YOU SEE WHERE YOU FACE, AN' TURNIN' IZ HOW YOU LOOK AROUND.

UNCOVERED GROUND IZ REMEMBERED PER MAP!

digging_and_secret_doors.title: DIGGIN' AN' SECRET DOORS
digging_and_secret_doors.description:
SOME WALLS CAN BE BROKEN THROUGH AT RUNTIME, TURNIN' A DEAD END INTO A ROUTE. DIGGIN' IZ DA DELIBERATE VERSION.

SECRET DOORS LOOK LIKE WALL UNTIL INTERACTED WIT, DEN FADE, MAKE A NOISE AN' STAY OPEN.

LOCKED DOORS GIVE THREE FIDDLY BITS. PEEK TELEPORTS YOU FOR A LOOK WITOUT LETTIN' YOU MOVE, AN' DA MENU DAT FOLLOWS HOLDS DA OTHER TWO: PICK, WHICH PLAYS A FALLIN' BLOCK MINIGAME AN' NEEDS LOCKPICKS, OR BREAK IN, WHICH IZ FILED AS A CRIME!

water,_climbing_and_bridges.title: WATER, CLIMBIN' AN' BRIDGES
water,_climbing_and_bridges.description:
FACE WATER AN' PRESS DA ACTION BUTTON: SWIM (NO RUNNIN'), FISH (NEEDS A ROD), OR DIVE.

CLIMBIN' IZ SLOW AN' COMPANIONS HIDE WHILE YOU CLIMB. JUMPIN' DOWN FROM HIGH UP HURTS, MORE DA FARTHER YOU FALL.

BRIDGES HAB LAYERS. WALK ON FROM DA APPROACH TA CROSS OVER IT; COME FROM ANYWHERE ELSE TA PASS UNDER IT.

A MIRROR SHOWS DA REFLECTION OF WHOEVER STANDS IN FRONT OF IT!

weather,_time_and_seasons.title: WEATHER, TIME AN' SEASONS
weather,_time_and_seasons.description:
DA CLOCK STARTS AT 8 AM ON 1 JANUARY 2001 AN' NEVER STOPS. TIME ADVANCES AS YOU WALK AN' JUMPS WHEN YOU SLEEP, WAIT OR TRAVEL.

WEATHER IZ GENERATED PER COUNTRY FROM DA DATE, AN' CHANGES ON ENTERIN' AN OUTDOOR MAP. DA COUNTRY SETS SUNRISE AN' SUNSET, SEASONAL TEMPERATURES, AN' WHICH WEATHER IZ POSSIBLE.

RAIN APPLIES WET, STORMS APPLY STATIC, SNOW APPLIES HOT, FROM DA BODY BURNIN' TA STAY WARM.

DA SCREEN IZ TINTED BY TIME OF DAY AN' BY TEMPERATURE, BLUE FOR COLD AN' RED FOR HOT. RAIN AN' NIGHT HAB DEY OWN AMBIENT SOUND CHANNEL!

dreams.title: DREAMS
dreams.description:
SLEEPIN' CAN DROP YOU INTO A DREAM: A 3D WORLD DAT MIXES PLACES LIKE BACKROOMS, OFFICES, ENDLESS STAIRS, DROWNED PLACES, COSMIC VOIDS, CAR PARKS, HOSPITALS, CATHEDRALS, FACTORIES, CARNIVALS, SEWERS, GARDENS AN' RUINS.

- WASD WALKS, DA MOUSE LOOKS, SPACE JUMPS. HOLD JUMP WHILE STANDIN' STILL TA TAKE OFF
- DA ACTION BUTTON USES DA WEAPON IN YA RIGHT HAND; DA WHEEL SWITCHES WEAPONS
- TOUCHIN' ANYTINK ALIVE TAKES YOU TA ANOTHER DREAM, AN' SO DOES WALKIN' STRAIGHT INTO A WALL
- HOLES HAB NO FLOOR, AN' FALLIN' FAR ENOUGH WAKES YOU UP

EACH DREAM HAB STRANGE RULES: BREATHIN' GROUND, ODD GRAVITY, INVERTED COLOURS, FIGURES DAT MOVE ONLY WHEN UNWATCHED, TIME SKIPS, CHANGIN' SIZE.

DREAMS NEVER END. TIME SPENT INSIDE CAN EARN KNOWLEDGE, REPORTED WHEN YOU WAKE!

adventures_on_the_map.title: ADVENTURES ON DA MAP
adventures_on_the_map.description:
SOME WORLD MAP SQUARES SHOW A "???" MARKER, REDRAWN ONCE A DAY. STAND ON IT AN' INVESTIGATE PLAYS A BRANCHIN' ADVENTURE WRITTEN FOR DAT PLACE.

DA LAST NODE PAYS OUT: A RELIC, GEAR, SALVAGE, MONEY, A FIGHT WIT SOMETINK NATIVE, A MINIGAME, AN AUGMENT, A CHANGE OF FACTION STANDIN', A CRIME FILED AGAINST YOU, A REST, OR NUTTIN'.

DA LEADER GOES IN AN' DA COMPANION AT DEY SHOULDER COMMENTS IN DEY OWN REGISTER. SOME CHOICES IZ ONLY OFFERED TA A LEADER OF A PARTICULAR TEMPERAMENT, AN' DA PROSE IZ COMBINATORIAL.

A BIOME HAB ONE MARKER, TWO IF IT IZ REAL LARGE, AN' A NAMED PLACE HAB ONE MORE. A RESOLVED SQUARE STAYS RESOLVED!

bologna.title: BOLOGNA
bologna.description:
BOLOGNA IZ IN DA GAME AS ITSELF, RASTERISED FROM OpenStreetMap INTO A GRID OF LARGE CELLS DAT JOIN SEAMLESSLY AT DA BORDERS.

EVERY RASTERISED BUILDIN' HAB A DOOR ON ITS SOUTH FACE AN' EVERY DOOR IZ A WAY IN. MOST IZ HOMES; A SHARE IZ SHOPS AN' INNS, SEEDED PER CELL AN' PER TILE, SO A DOOR IZ ALWAYS DA SAME BUSINESS.

DA CELLS HAB NO HAND PLACED EVENTS. DA CITY IZ POPULATED AT RUNTIME: TOWNSPEOPLE DRAWN FROM DA WORLD'S OWN FACES AN' FROM BOLOGNESI BORN DERE, PLUS WILDLIFE BY HABITAT, STREET ANIMALS ON PAVEMENTS, WATERFOWL AN' FISH IN DA CANALS, BIRDS ON ROOFTOPS!

platformer_maps.title: PLATFORMER MAPS
platformer_maps.description:
ON A MAP TAGGED AS A PLATFORM STAGE DA CONTROLS BECOME A SIDE SCROLLER: LEFT AN' RIGHT WALK, SPACE JUMPS, SHIFT RUNS, GRAVITY PULLS, AN' JUMPIN' AGAINST A WALL KICKS OFF IT.

LADDERS IZ CLIMBED WIT UP. COMPANIONS FOLLOW YA EXACT PATH A MOMENT BEHIND!

flying.title: FLYIN'
flying.description:
FLIGHT MOVES YOU LIKE AN AIRSHIP: FREELY, IN ANY DIRECTION, OVER EVERYTINK. CONFIRM LANDS YOU.

IT COMES FROM PARTICULAR ITEMS, SKILLS AN' VEHICLES RATHER DEN BEING HELD PERMANENTLY!

the_map_of_maps.title: DA MAP OF MAPS
the_map_of_maps.description:
A SECOND MAP SHOWS EVERY MAP YOU KNOW AN' HOW DEY CONNECT, BUILT FROM DA TRANSFER EVENTS AN' DOORS BETWEEN DEM.

CLICK A NODE TA SET IT AS DESTINATION AN' DA SHORTEST PATH LIGHTS UP. A COMPASS APPEARS IN DA CORNER POINTIN' AT DA NEXT WAYPOINT AN' GOES AWAY ON ARRIVAL!

chests_and_treasure_rooms.title: CHESTS AN' TREASURE ROOMS
chests_and_treasure_rooms.description:
CHEST CONTENTS SCALE WIT DA PARTY'S MEDIAN LEVEL. AN EMPTIED CHEST STAYS EMPTY, AN' OPEN CHESTS STAY OPEN.

SOME MAPS HIDE TREASURE ROOMS: REACHABLE, RANDOMLY PLACED ROOMS WIT RICHER CONTENTS!

research_and_discovery.title: RESEARCH AN' DISCOVERY
research_and_discovery.description:
EIGHT TREES OF DISCOVERY, ONE PER DISCIPLINE: SOCIAL SCIENCES, ALCHEMISTRY, TECHNOMAGICA, PHYSICS, ARCANE, MATHEMATICS, ASTRONOMY, THEOTECNICAL.

DA SCIENTIFIC TREES FOLLOW REAL PROGRESS FROM 2001 TA 2012. ARCANE AN' TECHNOMAGICA FOLLOW DA REDISCOVERY OF LOST MAGIC AN' ITS FUSION WIT MACHINERY. THEOTECNICAL FOLLOWS DA VATICAN REBUILDIN' ITS DOGMA AROUND ENGINES. EACH ALSO HAB FRINGE BRANCHES AN' A FEW NODES GENERATED FROM DA WORLD SEED.

COMPLETED NODES RECORD DA LEADER WHO GOT DERE FIRST. RESEARCHIN' ONE CONSUMES CRAFTIN' MATERIALS AN' RETURNS MOST OF DAT COST AS REFINED BYPRODUCTS!

fast_travel.title: FAST TRAVEL
fast_travel.description:
ANY PLACE MARKED AS A DESTINATION CAN BE TRAVELLED TA INSTEAD OF WALKED TA. BUS STOPS AN' SIGNPOSTS OPEN DA TRAVEL SCREEN.

A DESTINATION AN' A MODE PUT YOU ON A TRAVEL MAP FOR DAT TRANSPORT, WIT A COUNTDOWN DAT KEEPS RUNNIN' WHILE YOU OPEN MENUS OR FIGHT AN' SURVIVES SCENE CHANGES. AT ZERO YOU ARRIVE.

COMPANIONS TALK IN TRANSIT, VEHICLE CREWS SLEEP IN SHIFTS, AN' DA WORLD CLOCK KEEPS MOVIN'!

the_thirty_ways_to_travel.title: DA THIRTY WAYS TA TRAVEL
the_thirty_ways_to_travel.description:
EACH DESTINATION LISTS DA TRANSPORTS DAT REACH IT. DERE IZ THIRTY, TRADIN' MONEY FOR TIME.

WALKIN' IZ FREE AN' SLOWEST. A BICYCLE IZ CHEAP AN' A BIT FASTER, A HORSE BETTER STILL, AN' CAR SHARIN' OR DA CAMPER COST FUEL INSTEAD OF MONEY.

BUS, TRAIN, TAXI, BOAT AN' FERRY IZ DA ORDINARY FARES. DA TRAIN IZ GOOD VALUE; DA TAXI IZ AS FAST BUT COSTS MORE.

FLIGHTS, LIMOUSINES, HELICOPTERS AN' PRIVATE JETS IZ EXPENSIVE AN' FAST. CRUISES, SUBMARINES, BALLOONS AN' ZEPPELINS IZ SLOW AN' EXPENSIVE.

DA EXOTIC FIDDLY BITS INCLUDE MAGIC CARPETS, DRAGONS, TELEPORT CIRCLES, HYPERMETRO, MAGLEV, HYPERLOOP, STARSHIPS, WORMHOLES, QUANTUM JUMPS, TIME MACHINES AN' DIMENSIONAL CROSSINGS. DA FASTEST COST DA MOST.

LONGER TRIPS COST MORE!

owning_a_vehicle.title: OWNIN' A VEHICLE
owning_a_vehicle.description:
YOU OWN A VEHICLE IF YOU HOLD ITS KEY, DEED OR BROOM. IT DEN APPEARS IN DA VEHICLES MENU AN' CAN BE SUMMONED AN' DRIVEN.

VEHICLES STAY PARKED WHERE YOU LEAVE DEM. IF SEVERAL IZ ON ONE TILE, YOU WILL BE ASKED WHICH ONE YOU MEAN.

WALK UP TA A PARKED VEHICLE TA OPEN ITS MENU: DRIVE, ENTER, STORAGE, REFUEL, REPAIR.

DA CAMPER, DA CAR AN' DA STARSHIP HAB INTERIORS YOU CAN WALK IN, WIT STORAGE!

vehicle_the_camper.title: VEHICLE: DA CAMPER
vehicle_the_camper.description:
DA LARGEST VEHICLE. A HUNDRED LITRES OF FUEL, A WALK IN INTERIOR WIT BEDS AN' STORAGE, REPAIRABLE AN' UPGRADABLE, REFUELS AT ANY ROADSIDE PUMP.

A GROUND VEHICLE, SO IT CROSSES ROAD TILES FASTER DEN OPEN COUNTRY, AN' FAST TRAVEL BY CAMPER COSTS FUEL RATHER DEN MONEY.

TWO WORKSHOP MODULES EXTEND IT. AQUATIC MAKES IT FLOAT AN' DIVE, WIT C TA DIVE AN' SURFACE. FLIGHT FITS ROTORS, WIT F TA TAKE OFF AN' LAND.

DRIVIN' IT OPENS A 3D SCENE, AN' A CREW LIVES ABOARD IT!

vehicle_the_car.title: VEHICLE: DA CAR
vehicle_the_car.description:
FASTER DEN DA CAMPER AN' MUCH SMALLER. SIXTY LITRES OF FUEL, A LIL' INTERIOR, REFUELS AT ANY PUMP, TAKES DA ROAD BONUS, AN' FAST TRAVEL BY CAR COSTS FUEL RATHER DEN MONEY.

ANY PARKED CAR ON DA MAP CAN BE STOLEN: FACE IT, PRESS DA ACTION BUTTON AN' CHOOSE TA STEAL. DAT OPENS DA LOCKPICKIN' MINIGAME AN' NEEDS A LOCKPICK, OR A SKELETON KEY, WHICH OPENS IT OUTRIGHT. SUCCESS HANDS YOU ITS KEYS AN' REMOVES DA CAR FROM DA WORLD. FAILURE FILES A VEHICLE THEFT AGAINST YOU!

vehicle_the_bike.title: VEHICLE: DA BIKE
vehicle_the_bike.description:
HUMAN POWERED, SO IT NEEDS NO FUEL AN' NO CAN RUN DRY. DA FASTEST VEHICLE AVAILABLE EARLY, TAKES DA ROAD BONUS, AN' HAB NO INTERIOR, NO STORAGE AN' NO REPAIR COSTS.

NO CREW ROTA: DA RIDER DOES EVERYTINK!

vehicle_the_flying_broom.title: VEHICLE: DA FLYIN' BROOM
vehicle_the_flying_broom.description:
NEEDS NO FUEL, WORKS INDOORS, AN' STOWS INTO YA PACK AS AN ITEM.

IT FLIES, SO IT PASSES OVER EVERY TILE OF EVERY MAP: WALLS, WATER, CLIFFS AN' EVENTS. IT LANDS ON ANYTINK DAT CAN BE STOOD ON, ROOFTOPS AN' BRIDGES INCLUDED, AN' IZ BOARDED FROM DA TILE IT LANDED ON.

IT TAKES NO ROAD BONUS!

vehicle_the_boat.title: VEHICLE: DA BOAT
vehicle_the_boat.description:
AN INFLATABLE DINGHY. NO FUEL, NO INTERIOR, NO STORAGE, NO REPAIRS, AN' IT TRAVELS ONLY ON OPEN WATER.

DA PARTY IZ DRAWN ABOARD: EVERYONE ON DA BENCHES, BOW FIRST, FACIN' DA WAY DEY IZ GOING, WIT DA PET IN DA STERN!

vehicle_the_starship.title: VEHICLE: DA STARSHIP
vehicle_the_starship.description:
TWO HUNDRED LITRES OF FUEL AN' A FULL WALK IN INTERIOR. IT NO CAN BE REFUELLED AT A ROADSIDE PUMP.

HULL, LAYOUT AN' APPEARANCE IZ GENERATED FROM A SET OF TRAIT AXES AN' CAN BE EDITED.

IT NEEDS NO DRIVER AN' FLIES ITSELF, SO ITS CREW PAGE COVERS LIVIN' ABOARD RATHER DEN DRIVIN'. IT IZ USED FROM DA STAR MAP!

fuel.title: FUEL
fuel.description:
DA CAMPER, DA CAR AN' DA STARSHIP BURN FUEL. DA BIKE, DA BROOM AN' DA BOAT DO NO.

FUEL IZ BOUGHT AT PUMPS AT A PRICE DAT MOVES WIT DA WORLD'S OIL MARKET. DA CAMPER AN' DA CAR FILL AT ANY ROADSIDE PUMP; DA STARSHIP NO CAN.

CONSUMPTION IZ BY DISTANCE AN' DIFFERS PER VEHICLE, WIT A GAUGE IN DA CORNER WHILE DRIVIN'. RUNNIN' DRY STRANDS YOU!

vehicle_damage_and_repair.title: VEHICLE DAMAGE AN' REPAIR
vehicle_damage_and_repair.description:
A VEHICLE HAB TWELVE PARTS, EACH WIT ITS OWN HEALTH. ENGINE, TRANSMISSION, BRAKES AN' STEERIN' IZ CRITICAL AN' STOP IT DEAD WHEN BROKEN; BATTERY, ALTERNATOR, RADIATOR, FUEL SYSTEM, EXHAUST, SUSPENSION, TYRES AN' BODY ONLY COST PERFORMANCE.

DAMAGE COMES FROM WHAT YOU HIT. SOMETINK SOFT MARKS DA FRONT ONLY; ANOTHER VEHICLE AT ROAD SPEED IZ FELT THROUGHOUT. DA NOTIFICATION NAMES DA PARTS.

REPAIRS CONSUME CRAFTIN' MATERIALS, SCALED BY DA DEPTH OF DA REPAIR. WHILE RIDIN', DA VEHICLE'S CONDITION IZ DRAWN AS AN HP BAR ON DA PARTY HUD!

the_workshop.title: DA WORKSHOP
the_workshop.description:
VEHICLES IZ UPGRADED WIT CRAFTIN' MATERIALS AT DA WORKSHOP.

FOUR UPGRADES, THREE LEVELS EACH: ACCELERATION, SPEED, FUEL CAPACITY AN' STRUCTURAL HEALTH. TWO ONE OFF MODULES, CAMPER ONLY: AQUATIC, WHICH FLOATS AN' DIVES, AN' FLIGHT, WHICH FITS ROTORS.

AERODYNAMIC WORK REDUCES HOW MUCH GAME TIME A WORLD MAP TILE COSTS.

EACH LEVEL COSTS MORE EXOTIC MATERIALS, FROM STEEL AN' PLASTIC THROUGH TITANIUM AN' CIRCUITRY TA VARLENIAN MATTER, NANOTUBES AN' QUANTUM COMPONENTS!

the_crew.title: DA CREW
the_crew.description:
DA LEADER DRIVES WHEN A JOURNEY STARTS, AN' ONLY DA DRIVER EARNS DA VEHICLE'S SPECIALIZATION EXPERIENCE.

DRIVIN' TIRES PEOPLE OUT. WHEN DA DRIVER GETS TOO TIRED, DA BEST RESTED MEMBER TAKES OVER. IF NOBODY CAN, DA DRIVER KEEPS GOING AN' YOU IZ TOLD.

TIRED PASSENGERS NAP UNTIL RESTED OR UNTIL DA TRIP ENDS. DEY WAKE IF DA PARTY GETS OUT, SOMEONE ENTERS DA CABIN, OR DERE IZ A CRASH.

DA BIKE AN' DA BROOM HAB NO ROTA. DA STARSHIP FLIES ITSELF, AN' ITS CREW LOOKS AFTER DEY NEEDS FROM DA HOLD!

driving_in_3d.title: DRIVIN' IN 3D
driving_in_3d.description:
DRIVIN' DA CAMPER OPENS A 3D ROAD SCENE BUILT FROM DA WORLD MAP: DA SAME BIOMES, MOUNTAINS, WATER, ROADS, CITIES AN' FORESTS.

THREE VIEWS, SWITCHED WIT TAB OR Y: FIRST PERSON BEHIND DA WHEEL, CHASE CAMERA WIT ZOOM, AN' A FREE CABIN VIEW THROUGH A DOOR.

W ACCELERATES, SHIFT IZ TURBO, S BRAKES AN' REVERSES, A AN' D STEER, SPACE IZ DA HANDBRAKE, DA MOUSE LOOKS.

GRIP CHANGES WIT DA SURFACE, DA HANDBRAKE DRIFTS, AN' SLOPES MATTER.

TRAFFIC BRAKES, TAKES JUNCTIONS AN' CAN BE CRASHED INTO.

ON FOOT DA LEADER HOLDS DEY WEAPON, AN' DA D-PAD SWITCHES WEAPONS. ROADSIDE BAD 'UNS MATCH DA BIOME!

traffic,_roadkill_and_theft.title: TRAFFIC, ROADKILL AN' THEFT
traffic,_roadkill_and_theft.description:
CARS DRIVE AROUND DA MAPS ON DEY OWN.

ONLY MOVIN' CARS HIT TINKZ. TOWN TRAFFIC BRAKES FOR PEOPLE; HIGHWAY TRAFFIC DOES NO.

GETTIN' HIT KNOCKS YOU CLEAR AN' COUNTS AS AN ACCIDENT. NPCS HIT BY A CAR GET INJURED; CREATURES HIT HARD ENOUGH DIE.

RUNNIN' SOMEONE OVER INJURES DEM, MAKES DEM LIKE DA WHOLE PARTY LESS, AN' COUNTS AS A HIT AN' RUN. RAMMIN' DA SAME CREATURE OVER AN' OVER MAKES IT LIKELY TA FIGHT BACK.

SOMETIMES A DRIVER PULLS OVER AN' GETS OUT FOR A WHILE. DEY CAR STAYS PARKED AN' CAN BE STOLEN!

people_are_real_here.title: PEOPLE IZ REAL HERE
people_are_real_here.description:
EVERY PERSON ON DA MAP HAB A FULL PROFILE, GENERATED FROM DEY NAME AN' DA WORLD SEED:

- A PERSONALITY OUT OF TWENTY FIVE ARCHETYPES, WHICH SETS HOW DEY SPEAK
- TRAITS, DA SAME ONES YA CHARACTERS HAB
- AN IDEOLOGY ON FIVE AXES: ECONOMY, AUTHORITY, TRADITION, MILITARISM, MYSTICISM
- WEALTH, SKILLS, LOOT SACK AN' EQUIPMENT
- A FACTION, A HOME, A JOB AN' A SCHEDULE
- A BACKSTORY DRAWN FROM YA WORLD'S HISTORY
- A MEDICAL HISTORY, PAST DISEASES AN' BADLY HEALED BONES INCLUDED

PART OF DA POPULATION IZ ANIMALS, MINTED FROM DA SAME SYSTEM. A CREATURE ON A BEAST CLASS IZ NON SENTIENT: NO CONVERSATION, NO POLITICS, NO SAVINGS, NO PROPERTY!

the_empathize_panel.title: DA EMPATHIZE PANEL
the_empathize_panel.description:
TALKIN' TA SOMEONE PROPERLY OPENS DA EMPATHIZE PANEL: IDENTITY, HISTORY, BIOLOGY, HEALTH, ROMANTIC LIFE, DAILY LIFE, POLITICS, AN' A LOG OF DEY LAST CONVERSATIONS.

FROM IT YOU CAN TALK, PRAISE, INSULT, JOKE, GIVE, TRADE, COURT, PROPOSE, RECRUIT, AN' READ WHY DEY FEEL AS DEY DO 'BOUT YOU.

STANDINGS IZ PER PARTY MEMBER, AN' ONLY DA MEMBER DOING DA TALKIN' MOVES DEY.

A FREE CHAT FIELD TAKES TYPED INPUT AN' GENERATES A REPLY. WIT DA LOCAL LANGUAGE MODEL ENABLED IT WRITES DA REPLY; OTHERWISE A MARKOV CHAIN DOES!

how_somebody_decides_what_they_think_of_.title: HOW SOMEBODY DECIDES WHAT DEY TINK OF YOU
how_somebody_decides_what_they_think_of_.description:
AN NPC'S OPINION OF EACH OF YA CHARACTERS COMES FROM FOUR TINKZ:

- HOW YOU HAB TREATED DEM
- HOW WELL YA TRAITS MATCH
- HOW CLOSE YA POLITICS IZ
- HOW YOU BOTH SMELL RIGHT NOW

GAININ' STANDIN' ALSO FILLS DA COMPANY NEED OF WHOEVER GAINED IT.

ATTRACTION IZ SEPARATE. TALK, GIFTS AN' TRADE CHANGE OPINION; COURTIN' CHANGES ATTRACTION, AN' TRAITS AN' HYGIENE COUNT EXTRA DERE!

people_have_lives.title: PEOPLE HAB LIVES
people_have_lives.description:
EVERYONE'S LIFE ADVANCES WHENEVER TIME DOES: MINUTE BY MINUTE, AN' THROUGH ANY SKIP.

- DEY IZ BORN SOMEWHERE ON A DATE AN' KEEP A RECORD OF EVERY MOVE SINCE, WIT REASONS
- DEY MEET, DATE, MARRY, DIVORCE AN' SEPARATE, PREFERRIN' PARTNERS FROM DEY OWN SETTLEMENT
- DEY HOLD CAREERS FROM DA REAL JOB LIST, WIT A HISTORY FROM DEY FIRST WORKIN' YEAR, CHANGES AS DEY AGE, AN' RETIREMENT
- DISHONEST ONES HAB CONVICTIONS, SENTENCES SERVED OFF SCREEN AN' OUTSTANDIN' BOUNTIES, AN' A CONVICTION CAN COST SOMEONE DEY JOB

A YEAR SPENT IN CRYOGENIC SLEEP IZ A YEAR IN WHICH EVERYONE AGED, CHANGED JOBS, MARRIED AN' BURIED EACH OTHER!

what_people_say_to_each_other.title: WHAT PEOPLE SAY TA EACH OTHER
what_people_say_to_each_other.description:
TWO PEOPLE WHO WANDER CLOSE TOGETHER STOP, FACE EACH OTHER AN' HOLD A CONVERSATION, ONE LINE AT A TIME IN THOUGHT BUBBLES. DA TONE, POSITIVE, NEGATIVE, NEUTRAL OR A DEBATE, COMES FROM WHAT DEY TINK OF EACH OTHER AN' FROM DEY PERSONALITIES. FINISHIN' ONE MOVES BOTH OPINIONS.

PEOPLE SHARIN' A ROOM WHILE BUSY TRADE TWO LINE EXCHANGES WITOUT STOPPIN'.

EACH OF DA TWENTY FIVE PERSONALITIES HAB ITS OWN LINES FOR WEATHER AN' TIME OF DAY, ITS OWN INNER MONOLOGUE, AN' ITS OWN OPENERS AN' CLOSERS.

DA LAST TWENTY CONVERSATIONS OF EVERY PERSON CAN BE READ IN DEY PANEL!

settlements_and_what_happens_to_them.title: SETTLEMENTS AN' WHAT HAPPENS TA DEM
settlements_and_what_happens_to_them.description:
EVERY SETTLEMENT HAB THREE CIVIC METERS. PROSPERITY COMES FROM EMPLOYMENT, DA NATIONAL ECONOMY AN' RECENT EVENTS; SECURITY FROM CRIME PER HEAD, DA HONESTY OF DA LOCAL CAPTAIN OF DA GUARD, NATIONAL STABILITY AN' HOW WANTED YOU IZ; MOOD FROM DA OTHER TWO PLUS UNREST, FESTIVALS, EPIDEMICS AN' STREET TRAFFIC.

EPISODES SIT ON TOP OF DEM:

- CRIME WAVE: STARTS WHEN SECURITY COLLAPSES. CRIME PAYS BETTER AN' DA CRACKDOWN CATCHES MORE THIEVES, SO DA WAVE DIES DOWN
- BOOM AN' BUST: START AT DA EXTREMES OF PROSPERITY AN' SWING HIRIN', CRIME, DIVORCE, SHOP PRICES AN' MARKET SENTIMENT, DEN ERODE DEY OWN CAUSE
- FESTIVAL: DECLARED BY A THRIVIN' TOWN. MOOD AN' BUSTLE UP, SHOPS FULLER, PICKPOCKETS WORKIN' DA CROWDS
- EPIDEMIC: RARE, AN' WORSE IN MISERABLE TOWNS. MOOD, HIRIN' AN' SHOP TRAFFIC COLLAPSE UNTIL IT BURNS OUT

UNEMPLOYMENT FEEDS CRIME, CRIME FEEDS CRACKDOWNS, CRACKDOWNS FEED PRISONS, PRISONS FEED UNEMPLOYMENT. ALL OF IT REACHES DA NEWS, DA STOCK MARKET, HIRIN' AN' GOSSIP!

politics.title: POLITICS
politics.description:
EVERY HYPERPOWER HAB A GOVERNMENT, AN' DEY SHAPES DIFFER: THEOCRACIES, SINGLE PARTY STATES, PARLIAMENTARY MONARCHIES, TECHNOCRACIES, SULTANATES, DIVINE PANTHEONS, SERENE REPUBLICS, CORPORATOCRACIES, WARBAND CONFEDERACIES. EACH HAB PARTIES, ORDERS OR CLANS, A POLITICAL CLASS WIT CHARISMA, INTEGRITY, CUNNIN' AN' AMBITION, A HEAD OF STATE, AN' METERS FOR LEGITIMACY, STABILITY, UNREST, ECONOMY AN' TREASURY.

ELECTIONS RUN IN EACH POWER'S OWN IDIOM: GENERAL ELECTIONS, PAPAL CONCLAVES OVER SEVERAL BALLOTS, POLITBURO PLENUMS ANNOUNCIN' 99% RESULTS, WEALTH WEIGHTED SHAREHOLDER MEETINGS, GOBLIN MOOTS WHERE DA RUNNER UP RISKS BEING EATEN, DIVINE ASCENSION TOURNAMENTS, PALACE SUCCESSIONS, AN' DA ARCHIVE'S GREAT EXAMINATION.

BETWEEN ELECTIONS: SCANDALS, EDICTS, PROTESTS, RIOTS, COUPS, REVOLUTIONS, ASSASSINATIONS, REFERENDUMS, AN' RULERS AGEIN' AN' DYING.

EVERY PERSON HAB A POLITICAL IDENTITY: FIVE AXIS IDEOLOGY, A PARTY, AN ENGAGEMENT LEVEL FROM APATHETIC TA ORGANIZER, A VOTIN' RECORD, AN' GRUDGES AGAINST DA PARTIES DAT BEAT DEY.

EACH SETTLEMENT ELECTS A MAYOR EVERY YEAR, WHO APPOINTS A CAPTAIN OF DA GUARD, A TAX COLLECTOR AN' A HIGH PRIEST FROM AMONG DEY ALLIES!

factions_and_reputation.title: FACTIONS AN' REPUTATION
factions_and_reputation.description:
EIGHTEEN FACTIONS. STANDIN' WIT EACH RUNS FROM -100 TA +100, MOVED BY CONTRACTS TAKEN, CRIMES COMMITTED, ADVENTURES RESOLVED AN' SIDES TAKEN.

SOME FACTIONS BELONG TA A HYPERPOWER AN' IZ A BRANCH OF IT, SO CREDIT EARNED WIT DA PARENT CAN EXTEND TA ITS BRANCHES.

STANDIN' DECIDES WHAT WORK IZ OFFERED, WHAT PRICES IZ QUOTED, WHO WILL SPEAK TA YOU, AN' WHICH SEATS YOU MAY TAKE!

the_assembly.title: DA ASSEMBLY
the_assembly.description:
EVERY HYPERPOWER HOLDS A SEAT ON NEUTRAL GROUND INSIDE DA OMEGA TOWER. ONCE A WEEK OF GAME TIME DA DELEGATIONS ARGUE 'BOUT ALLIANCES, TRADE, WAR AN' RECENT EVENTS.

A PARTY MEMBER CAN TAKE A SEAT. DA SEAT, DA STANDIN' IT EARNS AN' DA WEEKLY STIPEND IZ DAT CHARACTER'S ALONE, AN' DA STIPEND SCALES WIT DEY STANDIN' WIT DA POWER DEY SERVE. LET IT FALL FAR ENOUGH AN' DEY IZ DISMISSED. ONLY POWERS DAT ALREADY TINK NEUTRALLY OR WELL OF DEM WILL TAKE DEM, A CHARACTER JOINS ONCE, AN' RESIGNIN' COSTS FAR MORE DEN JOININ' PAID.

A SESSION ROLLS ONE TA THREE MOTIONS. TWO TA FIVE DELEGATIONS TAKE DA FLOOR, EACH IN ITS OWN VOICE, YOU ANSWER, AN' EVERY SEAT VOTES. VOTES IZ EITHER PUBLIC, WIT EACH NAMED TILE TURNIN' GREEN OR RED, OR SECRET, WHERE ONLY DA TOTAL IZ SHOWN.

GRAVE MOTIONS, WAR, ADMISSION, TERRITORY, ARTIFACTS, THEONUCLEAR DEVICES AN' DA GOBLIN QUESTION, GO TA DA SECURITY COUNCIL: DA FIVE STRONGEST POWERS AFTER DA CENTURY OF HISTORY. MAJORITY CARRIES AN' DA SECRETARY GENERAL BREAKS A TIE; WITOUT ONE, DA MOTION FAILS.

DA TOURISTS HOLD A CHAIR WIT NO BALLOT, TAKE DA FLOOR WHEN DEY LIKE, AN' ADMIT NOBODY!

crime_and_bounty.title: CRIME AN' BOUNTY
crime_and_bounty.description:
EVERY CRIME IZ FILED BY NAME WIT ITS OWN BOUNTY VALUE, AN' YA BOUNTY IZ DA SUM OF DEM. DELIBERATE CRIMES: THEFT, BREAKIN' AN' ENTERIN', VEHICLE THEFT. ACCIDENTAL ONES TOO, SUCH AS RUNNIN' SOMEONE OVER.

BOUNTY LOWERS DA SECURITY METER OF SETTLEMENTS YOU IZ IN, BECOMES GOSSIP, CHANGES HOW DA GUARD BEHAVES, AN' IZ READ OUT IN COURT.

DA RECORD CAN BE VIEWED AT ANY TIME AN' SETTLED THROUGH DA POLICE PORTAL!

the_police_portal.title: DA POLICE PORTAL
the_police_portal.description:
DA N€POLICE APPLICATION ON DA HYPERNET IZ DA CONTINENTAL POLICE PORTAL, AN' IT SETTLES YA RECORD WITOUT WAITIN' FOR YOU TA BE CAUGHT.

- CASE FILE: EVERY CHARGE WIT ITS FINE, SETTLED ONE AT A TIME OR ALL AT ONCE
- SELF-REPORT: CONFESS SOMETINK NO YET REGISTERED, AT HALF DA USUAL FINE
- CUSTODY: TURN YOURSELF IN, OR REQUEST A HEARIN' BEFORE ERIS

BOTH CUSTODY FIDDLY BITS LEAVE DA COMPUTER, COZ DA CELLS AN' DA COURTROOM IZ PLACES ON DA MAP!

the_trial.title: DA TRIAL
the_trial.description:
JUSTICE IZ ADMINISTERED BY ERIS, AN' A TRIAL IZ GENERATED RATHER DEN SCRIPTED. DA COURTROOM, GALLERY, STAFF AN' AMBIENCE IZ ROLLED FRESH EACH TIME, AN' SHE CITES INVENTED CASE LAW AN' PRODUCES INVENTED EXHIBITS MID HEARIN'.

COUNSEL IZ RETAINED BEFORE DA HEARIN' OPENS: HIRE ONE OF FIVE ADVOCATES, NOMINATE A PARTY MEMBER, OR STAND ALONE. DA FIVE IZ PEOPLE FROM YA WORLD, FIXED FOR ITS LIFETIME, AN' RECRUITIN' ONE STRIKES DEM OFF DA BAR.

DA BRIEF SHOWS EACH OPTION'S LEVEL, INT, WIS, LAW LEVEL, OPINION OF YOU, FEE, AN' DA PROJECTED ODDS OF EVERY OUTCOME, COMPUTED WIT DA MODEL DA VERDICT RUNS ON. DA ODDS SWING ON ERIS'S MOOD, AN' IN SOME MOODS SHE THROWS COUNSEL OUT: YOU LOSE DEY BONUS AN' DA FEE IZ NO REFUNDED.

DEFENDIN' YOURSELF, OR HAVIN' A COMPANION DEFEND YOU, EARNS A FEW POINTS OF DA LAW SPECIALIZATION PER HEARIN', WHICH IMPROVES DA ODDS. A PROFESSIONAL TEACHES DA PARTY NUTTIN'.

DA HEARIN' IZ A PLEA, DEN A SERIES OF CHOICES, DEN A VERDICT DAT DEPENDS HEAVILY ON HER MOOD. EVENINGS SPENT WIT ERIS RAISE A BOND, AN' A DEFENDANT SHE HAB DINED WIT MEETS A WARMER MOOD WHEEL, A LOWER CONVICTION CHANCE AN' SHORTER SENTENCES.

SANDBOX MODE HAB A REVERSE TRIAL, WHERE YOU PLAY ERIS!

sentences_and_prison.title: SENTENCES AN' PRISON
sentences_and_prison.description:
SENTENCES COME IN TWO SHAPES. A NAMED TERM IZ SERVED BY DA GAME CLOCK: TIME PASSES IN DA CELLS AN' DA BOUNTY IZ CLEARED ON RELEASE. AN OPEN ENDED SENTENCE HAB NO RELEASE DATE AN' GRINDS DA BOUNTY DOWN DAY BY DAY.

TURNIN' YOURSELF IN AT DA POLICE PORTAL GOES STRAIGHT TA DA SECOND KIND WITOUT A HEARIN'.

ON RELEASE, ERIS COMMENTS BASED ON YA RELATIONSHIP!

dating_eris.title: DATIN' ERIS
dating_eris.description:
ERIS CAN BE COURTED, AN' AN EVENIN' WIT HER IZ A GENERATED SCENE.

IT HAPPENS IN A BIOME, AN' EACH BIOME OWNS ITS OPENIN', ITS QUESTIONS, ITS ROMANTIC BEAT, ITS CHAOTIC BEAT, ITS SHARED ACTIVITY AN' ITS LOCAL INCIDENTS. A SCENARIO IZ ROLLED ON TOP, PICNIC, SEANCE, STAKEOUT AN' OTHERS, SO ONE BIOME HOSTS MANY EVENINGS.

HER MOOD IZ ROLLED FROM SIXTEEN: PLAYFUL, ROMANTIC, CHAOTIC, NERVOUS, CONFIDENT, CARIN', GUILTY, CRAZED, PSYCHED OUT, HIGH ON SOLIPSISM, ELDRITCH, MELANCHOLY, SMUG, PARANOID, PROPHETIC, BORED. IT CAN SHIFT MID DATE. IN DA ELDRITCH MOOD HER LINES WARP, HER PULSE READS TINKZ DAT IZ NO NUMBERS, AN' DA PORTRAIT MISBEHAVES.

EACH DATE ALSO ROLLS A REGISTER, SINCERE, CAPRICIOUS OR COMPLETELY BONKERS, WHICH SCALES HOW OFTEN DA EVENIN' IZ INTERRUPTED AN' HOW HARD HER FEELINGS SWING. SHE INTERRUPTS WIT DARES, UP TA ROBBIN' A BANK. YA OWN ANSWERS IZ GENERATED TOO, AN' HOW SHE TAKES ONE IZ A ROLL OF HER MOOD.

TWO HEARTBEATS IZ DRAWN ON SCREEN, YA AN' HERS. SHE REMEMBERS PAST DATES, KEEPS A SEPARATE SCORE FOR EVERY PARTY MEMBER, AN' SOMETIMES TURNS TOWARDS ONE OF YA COMPANIONS MID DATE.

DA FIRST DATE DAT ENDS WELL PAYS AN EXPRESSION SEED, ONCE PER STASH!

the_post.title: DA POST
the_post.description:
YOU CAN WRITE TA ANOTHER PARTY IN DA SAME WORLD, OR IN A DIFFERENT WORLD ON YA COMPUTER. DA LETTER WAITS UNTIL SOMEONE PLAYS DAT PARTY.

YOU CAN SET A DELIVERY DATE DAYS, MONTHS OR YEARS AHEAD. A DELAYED LETTER TA YA OWN PARTY IZ A LETTER TA YA FUTURE SELF.

MONEY AN' GOODS CAN BE ENCLOSED. DEY LEAVE YA POCKETS AT ONCE AN' ARRIVE WHEN DA LETTER IZ COLLECTED.

POST INSIDE ONE WORLD IZ FREE. SENDIN' TA ANOTHER WORLD IZ REAL EXPENSIVE, AN' DA PRICE FOLLOWS OIL AN' SOUL PRICES!

the_news.title: DA NEWS
the_news.description:
DA WORLD WRITES ITS OWN NEWS, AN' NEWS ITEMS HAB EFFECTS: PROPERTY PRICES, SHOP OCCUPANCY, MARKET SENTIMENT.

SETTLEMENT EPISODES, RIOTS, COUPS, ELECTIONS, EPIDEMICS AN' DA MAYOR'S DIVORCE ALL BECOME HEADLINES. DA REAL ESTATE MARKET MOVES ON DEM, DA STOCK MARKET TAKES SENTIMENT FROM DEM, AN' PEOPLE TALK 'BOUT DEM!

the_party_diary.title: DA PARTY DIARY
the_party_diary.description:
DA DIARY IZ DA RECORD ONE PARTY KEEPS OF ITS OWN LIFE, WRITTEN AS IT HAPPENS.

IT TAKES IN JOURNEYS AN' ARRIVALS, LANDINGS AN' WARPS, FIRST ENTRY INTO A NAMED PLACE, DUNGEON FLOORS, SLEEPIN' AN' WAITIN', CRYOGENIC SLEEP, FIGHTS WON AN' LOST, BOSSES, ARENA STREAKS, PEOPLE JOININ' AN' LEAVIN', DEATHS, LEVELS, PETS, CREATURES TALKED ROUND, BIRTHS, FRIENDSHIPS, ENMITIES, COURTSHIPS, EVENINGS WIT ERIS, DISEASES, LIMBS LOST, AUGMENTS, SURGERY, NOTABLE FINDS, PURCHASES AN' SALES, THEFTS, PROPERTY, LOANS, SHARE TRADES, CRIMES, TRIALS, PRISON, SHIFTS WORKED, CROPS, FORGIN', COOKIN', BREWIN', BUILDIN', SKILLS, RESEARCH, QUESTS, BESTIARY ENTRIES, MINIGAMES, TELEVISION AN' DREAMS.

NO RECORDED: ORDINARY CONVERSATION, STATUE DESCRIPTIONS, STATES COMIN' AN' GOING, DISCARDED ITEMS.

ENTRIES IZ STORED AS KEYS, SO A DIARY WRITTEN IN ONE LANGUAGE READS CORRECTLY IN ANOTHER. DA BANTER SYSTEM TAKES DA NEWEST LINES AN' TURNS DEM INTO WHAT DA PARTY TALKS 'BOUT!

conversation_topics.title: CONVERSATION TOPICS
conversation_topics.description:
SOME DIALOGUE TEACHES A TOPIC, WRITTEN IN SQUARE BRACKETS IN DA LINE WHERE IT APPEARS. ONCE ONE CHARACTER HEARS IT, DA WHOLE PARTY KNOWS IT.

A DIALOGUE OPTION DAT REQUIRES A TOPIC STAYS HIDDEN UNTIL YOU KNOW IT, RATHER DEN GREYED OUT.

EVERY TOPIC LEARNED IZ ANNOUNCED. DA TOPICS TAB OF DIS BOOK LISTS DEM WIT WHO KNOWS EACH ONE, AN' SOME HAB A PAGE OF DEY OWN!

armies.title: ARMIES
armies.description:
BEYOND DA PARTY OF THREE DERE IZ AN ARMY. TROOPS IZ RECRUITED BY FACTION, UP TA A HUNDRED, AN' DA COUNT IZ DRAWN OVER YA SPRITE ON DA WORLD MAP.

OTHER ARMIES FILL DA WORLD MAP. 'BOUT A FIFTH IZ FACTION ARMIES OF TWO HUNDRED TA A THOUSAND TROOPS, WHICH STAY INSIDE DEY OWN COUNTRY'S BORDERS. DA REST IZ INDEPENDENT BANDS OF FIVE TA THIRTY, WHICH ROAM ANYWHERE AN' SPAWN NEAR YOU.

TOUCHIN' ONE STARTS A FIELD BATTLE IN A REAL TIME TACTICAL VIEW: YA UNITS IN YELLOW, DEY IN RED, FORMED UP BY ROLE, CLOSE QUARTERS IN FRONT, SUPPORT BEHIND, RANGED AT DA BACK, FIGHTIN' ON DEY OWN STATS. WOUNDED TROOPS DROP TA ONE HIT POINT AN' STOP; KILLED TROOPS IZ GONE FOR GOOD!

multiplayer.title: MULTIPLAYER
multiplayer.description:
TWO WAYS TA PLAY WIT OTHER PEOPLE.

ONLINE, THROUGH A CENTRAL SERVER OR THROUGH STEAM. A SERVER SESSION SUPPORTS MANY PLAYERS, OF WHOM DA NEAREST EIGHT IZ DRAWN ON ONE MAP. A STEAM LOBBY CAPS AT EIGHT AN' SETS RICH PRESENCE, SO MATES SEE JOIN GAME IN DEY LIST.

LOCAL SPLIT SCREEN, TWO PLAYERS ON ONE MACHINE WIT A GAMEPAD EACH. DA VIEWPORTS IZ INDEPENDENT AN' MERGE INTO ONE WHEN DA PLAYERS IZ CLOSE, AN' PLAYER TWO INTERACTS WIT EVENTS DIRECTLY.

SPLIT SCREEN ALSO RUNS A HOT SEAT FOR MINIGAMES WITOUT A SPLIT SCREEN SESSION ON DA OVERWORLD. REAL TIME ARCADE CARTS LET EITHER PLAYER STEER; CHESS, POOL AN' BOWLIN' ALTERNATE TURNS.

DURIN' A MAP BATTLE DA VIEWPORTS MERGE AN' PLAYER TWO DRIVES DA SECOND PARTY MEMBER!

the_century_behind_you.title: DA CENTURY BEHIND YOU
the_century_behind_you.description:
BEFORE YOU TAKE A STEP, DA WORLD HAB LIVED THROUGH A CENTURY: A GENERATED ALTERNATE HISTORY OF EUROPE FROM 1900 TA 2001.

IT PRODUCES COUPS, ELECTIONS, PURGES AN' ASSASSINATIONS; WARS, SIEGES, MUTINIES AN' CONQUESTS; FIFTY KINDS OF PARANORMAL ANOMALY, OCCULT RITES AN' DA SQUISHING ITSELF; SCIENTIFIC EXPEDITIONS, NATURAL DISASTERS AN' ORGANISED CRIME; ECONOMIC SHIFTS AN' TECHNOLOGICAL BREAKTHROUGHS. DA WEIGHTIN' FAVOURS DA PARANORMAL AN' DA OCCULT.

DAT HISTORY SETS WHICH HYPERPOWERS EXIST AN' HOW STRONG DEY IZ, WHICH FIVE SIT ON DA SECURITY COUNCIL, WHAT EPIDEMICS DA LAST CENTURY SAW, AN' WHAT DA PEOPLE YOU MEET LIVED THROUGH.

DA FULL TIMELINE IZ READABLE IN DA HISTORICAL ARCHIVE!

money.title: MONEY
money.description:
MONEY IZ EUROS, WRITTEN WIT TWO DECIMAL PLACES.

DERE IZ NO OTHER CURRENCY EXCEPT AT DA ARCADE, WHERE EUROS BUY TOKENS AN' TOKENS SELL BACK AT A FIXED RATE.

DA ASSETS SCREEN ADDS CASH, BANK BALANCE, PROPERTY, SHARES AN' LIVESTOCK, SUBTRACTS DEBTS, AN' CALLS DA RESULT NET WORTH!

shops.title: SHOPS
shops.description:
DERE IZ SEVERAL KINDS OF SHOP.

- COUNTER SHOP: GOODS BY CATEGORY, SORTED BY PRICE, WIT A DETAIL CARD
- DELIVERY ORDER: ARRIVES IN A FEW DAYS, CHEAPER ITEMS SOONER
- RANDOM DAILY SHOP: DIFFERENT STOCK EVERY DAY
- VENDIN' MACHINE: A GRID OF CODED PRODUCTS, WIT A DAILY LIMIT PER SLOT
- TEACHIN' SHOP: SELLS SKILLS INSTEAD OF GOODS, AT A DISCOUNT

EVERYTINK EXCEPT SKILLS IZ TAXED, AN' DA RATE FOLLOWS DA ECONOMY. EMPTY SHOPS RESTOCK AT MIDNIGHT!

stealing.title: STEALIN'
stealing.description:
ANYTINK ON A SHOP'S SHELVES CAN BE STOLEN. DA STEAL WINDOW LISTS WHAT NEARBY SHOPS HOLD, WIT YA CHANCE FOR EACH ITEM. AGILITY HELPS; HEAVY AN' VALUABLE ITEMS IZ HARDER.

DAILY MERCHANTS CAN ONLY BE ROBBED FROM CLOSE BY.

GETTIN' CAUGHT IZ A CRIME AN' MAKES DA TOWN LESS SAFE. DURIN' A CRIME WAVE, STEALIN' IZ HARDER!

banking_and_loans.title: BANKIN' AN' LOANS
banking_and_loans.description:
DA BANK TAKES DEPOSITS, PAYS INTEREST ON DA BALANCE, AN' LENDS AT INTEREST AGAINST A DUE DATE. BOTH RUN ON DA WORLD CLOCK, SO DEY ACCRUE WHILE YOU WALK, SLEEP, TRAVEL OR SIT IN CRYOGENIC SLEEP.

MISSIN' DA DUE DATE IZ PENALISED. DA ASSETS SCREEN SHOWS DA BALANCE, DA OUTSTANDIN' LOAN AN' DA DATE!

the_stock_market.title: DA STOCK MARKET
the_stock_market.description:
DA MARKET TRADES TWO COMMODITIES, OIL AN' SOUL CRYSTALS, FROM A SINGLE PAGE TERMINAL. PRICES MOVE AT RANDOM, PUSHED BY WHAT HAPPENS IN DA WORLD: SETTLEMENT BOOMS AN' BUSTS, NEWS EVENTS, DA STATE OF DA POWERS.

DA ASSETS SCREEN DRAWS DA LIVE GRAPH OVER YA PORTFOLIO. DA OIL PRICE IZ ALSO WHAT DA FUEL PUMP CHARGES AN' WHAT A LETTER TA ANOTHER DIMENSION COSTS!

real_estate.title: REAL ESTATE
real_estate.description:
PROPERTIES ACROSS DA TOWNS IZ RATED ONE TA FIVE STARS. CHEAP ONES IZ AFFORDABLE; FOUR AN' FIVE STARS IZ ESTATES.

BUY ONE AN' YOU CAN RENT IT TA NPCS FOR REGULAR INCOME. RENT ONE YOURSELF AN' YOU PAY MONTHLY, WIT NO SUBLETTIN'; MISS PAYMENTS AN' YOU IZ EVICTED.

PRICES MOVE WIT LOCAL NEWS.

INN ROOMS IZ SEPARATE: ONE BOOKIN' COVERS A FULL DAY!

owning_a_shop.title: OWNIN' A SHOP
owning_a_shop.description:
A SHOP YOU OWN HOLDS STOCK, A WAREHOUSE AN' A PRODUCTION LINE. ITEMS WIT RECIPES CAN BE PRODUCED FROM MATERIALS ON DA PREMISES, DELIVERIES IZ MADE AT DELIVERY POINTS ON DA MAPS, AN' NPC STAFF CAN BE HIRED TA DO DA WORK.

FOUR PAGES: OVERVIEW, SHELF STOCK, WAREHOUSE, AN' DA CATALOGUE OF WHAT CAN BE PRODUCED!

work.title: WORK
work.description:
MORE DEN THIRTY JOBS ACROSS SEVERAL CATEGORIES, AN' ANY PARTY MEMBER CAN BE SENT TA WORK.

EACH JOB STATES ITS STAT REQUIREMENTS FIRST, AN' A MEMBER SHORT OF DEM IZ FLAGGED BUT NEVER BLOCKED.

A SHIFT TAKES GAME TIME, DA SCREEN DARKENS, AN' DA OUTCOME IZ GENERATED FROM DA WORKER'S STATS AN' LUCK. PAY IZ MONEY; A DISASTER CAN COST MONEY, DEAL DAMAGE, OR LEAVE A STATUS EFFECT.

DA JOB OFFERS MENU LISTS WHAT IZ AVAILABLE NOW AN' WHERE!

quests.title: QUESTS
quests.description:
QUESTS IZ GENERATED, AN' EACH BOARD OFFERS JOBS DAT SUIT WHERE IT STANDS.

A QUEST HAB ONE OR MORE STEPS:

- REACH A PLACE ON DA WORLD MAP
- OPEN A HIDDEN CHEST, OR DIG A SITE (NEEDS A SHOVEL)
- LAND ON A PLANET AN' OPEN ITS SAMPLE CACHE
- KILL A SPECIFIC STRONG BAD 'UN
- SCAN STATUES OR SIGNPOSTS, OR CLEAR TREES, ROCKS OR RUBBLE
- VISIT ANOTHER TOWN'S BOARD, OR INTERVIEW SOMEONE THROUGH EMPATHIZE
- HAND OVER ITEMS, OR WAIT FOR A DELIVERY
- WIN ARENA FIGHTS, DEFEAT BAD 'UNS, OR HOLD OIL SHARES

TERMS IZ SHOWN BEFORE YOU ACCEPT: REWARD, COST, DEADLINE, PENALTIES AN' REPUTATION. SCAMS LIE 'BOUT DEM.

REWARDS AN' DIFFICULTY FOLLOW YA PARTY'S LEVEL. DA BOARD'S SECOND TAB TRACKS YA CONTRACTS, WHERE YOU COLLECT OR ABANDON DEM.

DA QUEST LOG IZ A BOARD OF STICKY NOTES IN THREE COLUMNS DAT YOU CAN DRAG BETWEEN!

reading_a_notice.title: READIN' A NOTICE
reading_a_notice.description:
A QUEST NOTICE IZ WRITTEN IN DA VOICE OF WHOEVER PINNED IT UP. DOZENS OF FACTION REGISTERS AN' A COUPLE OF DOZEN PERSONALITY REGISTERS EXIST: A CORPORATE CONTRACT, A GOBLIN SCRAWL, A REDACTED MILITARY BILL, A NERVOUS PRIVATE PLEA.

WHAT IZ LEFT OUT, WHAT IZ OVER EXPLAINED AN' WHAT IZ PLAINLY A LIE IZ READABLE BEFORE YOU ACCEPT. DA TERMS PANEL GIVES DA NUMBERS!

arcade_tokens.title: ARCADE TOKENS
arcade_tokens.description:
ARCADE MACHINES TAKE TOKENS. TOKENS IZ BOUGHT WIT EUROS AT DA CONVERTER MACHINE OR AT DA TOKEN EXCHANGE ON DA HYPERNET, AN' UNUSED TOKENS CAN BE CASHED BACK IN.

BOTH QUOTE DA SAME RATE!

the_workbench.title: DA WORKBENCH
the_workbench.description:
DA THINKER IZ DA GENERAL WORKBENCH: ASSEMBLIN' AN' DISMANTLIN'. DA RECIPE IZ WRITTEN ON DA ITEM.

A RECIPE STAYS HIDDEN UNTIL IT HAB BIN MADE ONCE, THOUGH COMMON ONES IZ ON DA BOARD FROM DA START.

BASE MATERIALS COME FROM DISMANTLIN' DA WORLD: FELLIN' TREES, MININ' ROCKS, BREAKIN' FURNITURE, SALVAGIN' GEAR!

the_forge.title: DA FORGE
the_forge.description:
EVERY WEAPON AN' ARMOUR IN DA GAME IZ ON DA FORGE BOARD FROM YA FIRST VISIT. TRAININ' DECIDES WHAT YOU CAN MAKE.

FOUR TABS: WHAT YOU CAN MAKE NOW, WHAT YOU LACK MATERIALS FOR, WHAT NEEDS MORE TRAININ', AN' WHAT DIS PARTY HAB ALREADY FORGED.

EACH ITEM BELONGS TA A TRADE: A ROBE IZ TAILORIN', A WIG IZ WIG MAKIN', A RIFLE IZ GUNSMITHIN', A CIRCUIT COAT IZ ELECTRONICS.

EVERY FORGED PIECE IZ UNIQUE AN' NO STACK. BETTER TRAININ' AN' BETTER MATERIALS MAKE BETTER PIECES.

PICK A FINISH FROM DA SWATCHES.

SMELT TURNS A CARRIED PIECE BACK INTO SOME OF ITS MATERIALS, MORE FOR A WELL MADE ONE.

DA PARTY SWITCHER SETS WHO FORGES AN' WHO EARNS DA SPECIALIZATION POINTS!

alchemistry.title: ALCHEMISTRY
alchemistry.description:
