EVERY ALCHEMY RECIPE IZ OPEN FROM DA START, FOR ANY CLASS.

COPY A RECIPE ONTO A BENCH, DEN EDIT AN' RUN DA BENCH. ONE RECIPE CAN RUN ON TWO BENCHES SET UP DIFFERENTLY.

SUCCESS DEPENDS ON SKILL. MEET EVERY REQUIREMENT AN' YOU NEVER FAIL; FALL SHORT AN' FAILURE BECOMES LIKELY; GO BEYOND AN' YOU GET EXTRA PRODUCT.

STEPS TAKE GAME TIME, SO A BATCH KEEPS GOING WHILE YOU WALK, WORK, TRAVEL OR SLEEP.

A BENCH SET TA REPEAT BUYS ITS INGREDIENTS AN' STARTS AGAIN, AN' STOPS WIT A WARNIN' WHEN YOU NO CAN AFFORD A RUN!

cooking.title: COOKIN'
cooking.description:
COOKIN' COMBINES TWO RECOVERY ITEMS INTO ONE. DA FIRST ITEM'S RECOVERY IZ DOUBLED AN' DA SECOND'S IZ ADDED, SO ORDER MATTERS.

COOKIN' TWO OF DA SAME TINK ADDS A RANDOM ADJECTIVE INSTEAD, WIT A BONUS OR A PENALTY. DA NAME IZ BUILT FROM DA FIRST WORD OF DA FIRST INGREDIENT AN' DA LAST WORD OF DA SECOND.

FOOD HAB CALORIES, FAT AN' PROTEIN, AN' A COOKED MEAL IZ WORTH WHAT WENT INTO IT!

brewing.title: BREWIN'
brewing.description:
BARRELS FERMENT ON DA WORLD CLOCK. LOAD A BARREL, LEAVE IT, AN' BREWIN' AN' DISTILLIN' PROCEED WHILE YOU PLAY.

IT IZ DA SLOWEST CRAFTIN' AN' NEEDS NO ATTENTION!

building_and_furniture.title: BUILDIN' AN' FURNITURE
building_and_furniture.description:
DA BUILD MENU PLACES FURNITURE ON TILES, SNAPPED TA DA GRID. PIECES CAN BE CRAFTED FROM MATERIALS, BOUGHT, AN' DISMANTLED TA RECOVER DEM. MULTI TILE PIECES IZ SUPPORTED AN' SOME CAN BE FLIPPED.

WALL FURNITURE GOES ON WALLS ONLY, DA UPPER TILES OF ORDINARY FURNITURE MAY OVERLAP A WALL BUT DA LOWER TILES MAY NO, AN' SOME TERRAIN REFUSES FURNITURE.

DA BUILD MENU IZ ALSO WHERE ANIMALS IZ BOUGHT!

farming.title: FARMIN'
farming.description:
ANY TILLED SOIL CAN BE FARMED. PLANTS GROW WIT TIME, SEASON AN' WEATHER.

DEY GROW ONLY IN DEY SEASONS AN' REST OUTSIDE DEM. RAIN AN' STORMS SPEED GROWTH, SNOW SLOWS IT, AN' GREENHOUSES GROW ALL YEAR. A FULLY GROWN PLANT IZ HARVESTED ON DA SPOT; DA MANAGEMENT MENU OPENS ONLY ON PLOTS STILL GROWIN'.

TILLED SOIL ON GENERATED MAPS CAN BE FARMED TOO, AN' SOME FIELDS IZ ALREADY SOWN WHEN YOU FIRST ARRIVE!

animals.title: ANIMALS
animals.description:
ANIMALS IZ BOUGHT IN DA BUILD MENU AN' PLACED ON A TILE, DEN MANAGED FROM DA ASSETS SCREEN AS LIVESTOCK TA COLLECT FROM, SELL, OR TURN INTO A PET.

DEY GROW FROM BABY TA ADULT OVER A SET NUMBER OF DAYS, AN' ADULTS PRODUCE AT INTERVALS: AN EGG, A PAIL OF MILK, A FLEECE.

EVERY ANIMAL HAB A COMPANY VALUE DAT FILLS DA PARTY'S SOCIAL NEED WHEN YOU INTERACT WIT IT, ONCE PER GAME DAY. DOGS, DONKEYS AN' ROOSTERS PRODUCE NUTTIN' AN' IZ KEPT FOR DIS!

beekeeping.title: BEEKEEPIN'
beekeeping.description:
A HIVE IZ A COLONY SIMULATION. QUEEN, WORKERS, NURSES, GUARDS, FORAGERS AN' DRONES EACH HAB A LIFECYCLE FROM EGG THROUGH LARVA AN' PUPA TA ADULT AN' DEATH. DA COMB IZ DRAWN AS HEXAGONS, AN' DA COLONY PRODUCES HONEY, POLLEN, ROYAL JELLY AN' WAX.

SEASONS AN' WEATHER ACT ON IT, DISEASE AN' PESTS THREATEN IT, AN' ITS MOOD AN' EFFICIENCY FOLLOW HOW IT IZ KEPT!

procedural_artifacts.title: PROCEDURAL ARTIFACTS
procedural_artifacts.description:
ARTIFACTS IZ GENERATED ITEMS, WEAPONS AN' ARMOUR WIT ROLLED PROPERTIES. DEY APPEAR IN LOOT, IN VAULTS, AT DA END OF ADVENTURES, AN' FROM CERTAIN RITES.

ONE RITE TURNS A PARTY MEMBER INTO A WEAPON!

how_loot_is_rolled.title: HOW LOOT IZ ROLLED
how_loot_is_rolled.description:
RANDOM LOOT GETS BETTER AS YA PARTY LEVELS UP, AN' HARDER PLACES DROP BETTER LOOT.

RARITY FOLLOWS PRICE, AN' DA SAME COLOURS MARK ITEM NAMES IN DA BACKPACK, SHOPS, REWARDS AN' CONTAINERS.

HOLY PATRON BUNKERS DROP ESPECIALLY VALUABLE LOOT!

containers.title: CONTAINERS
containers.description:
CONTAINERS HOLD ITEMS WITOUT LIMIT, AN' EACH IZ UNIQUE TA ITS MAP AN' EVENT. CONTENTS IZ GENERATED FROM DA CATEGORIES DA CONTAINER DECLARES, WEIGHTED BY RARITY.

DA EXTRADIMENSIONAL CONTAINER CAN BE OPENED FROM ANYWHERE AN' TRAVELS WIT DA PARTY, AS DO DA HOLDS OF DA CAMPER AN' DA CAR!

the_star_map.title: DA STAR MAP
the_star_map.description:
DA STAR MAP IZ A REAL TIME 3D VIEW OF DA UNIVERSE AT SEVERAL SCALES: DA SYSTEM YOU IZ IN, DA GALAXY, DA LOCAL GROUP, DA SUPERCLUSTER, DA COSMIC WEB AN' DA OBSERVABLE UNIVERSE. AT SYSTEM SCALE ONE UNIT IZ ONE ASTRONOMICAL UNIT, AN' BODIES IZ DRAWN LARGER DEN LIFE TA STAY VISIBLE.

DRAG TA ORBIT, WHEEL TA ZOOM. CLICKIN' A BODY SELECTS IT AN' OFFERS WHAT YOU CAN DO: TRAVEL DERE, OR LAND.

PLANETS HAB DAY AN' NIGHT TERMINATORS TRACKIN' DEY OWN STAR, INDEPENDENTLY TURNIN' CLOUD LAYERS, ATMOSPHERES AN' RINGS. STAR SURFACES BOIL!

travelling_between_stars.title: TRAVELLIN' BETWEEN STARS
travelling_between_stars.description:
SELECT A SYSTEM AN' TRAVEL TA IT. DA JOURNEY TAKES TIME AN' BURNS FUEL, AN' FUEL SETS YA RANGE.

ONLY AN ORDINARY FUSIN' STAR CAN POWER A REFUEL. MAIN SEQUENCE STARS OF EVERY CLASS WORK; REMNANTS, BROWN DWARFS AN' BLACK HOLES DO NO. REFUEL STARTS DA PUMPS IF YOU IZ PARKED AT ONE, PLOTS A SHORT HOP IF DERE IZ ONE ELSEWHERE IN DA SYSTEM, AN' OTHERWISE PLOTS A COURSE TA DA NEAREST SYSTEM DAT HAB ONE.

ON ANY MAP INSIDE DA SHIP DA WINDOWS SHOW WHERE YOU ACTUALLY IZ, AN' DEY STREAK AN' SCROLL WHILE UNDER WAY!

your_starship.title: YA STARSHIP
your_starship.description:
DA SHIP IZ GENERATED. HULL, LAYOUT, PLATIN', PANEL LINES, LIVERY, DECALS, LIT WINDOWS AN' WEAR IZ ALL PROCEDURAL, AN' DA DEFAULT APPEARANCE COMES FROM YA WORLD'S SEED.

FROM DA VEHICLE MENU YOU CAN REROLL DA WHOLE TINK OR STEP THROUGH INDIVIDUAL TRAITS AN' KEEP DA REST.

UNDER WAY DA CREW TENDS ONE NEED AT A TIME: A MEAL, A WASH, A CONVERSATION, A GAME, A SHIFT OF SLEEP. EATIN' CONSUMES FOOD FROM DA HOLD!

landing.title: LANDIN'
landing.description:
IN ORBIT YOU CAN LAND. WHERE LANDIN' SITES EXIST YOU PICK FROM A LIST; OTHERWISE YOU TOUCH DOWN ON DA SURFACE.

AN ALIEN SURFACE IZ AN EXPLORABLE MAP, GENERATED LIKE EARTH'S BUT FROM A DIFFERENT PALETTE, WIT DOZENS OF ALIEN BIOMES CHOSEN BY DA TYPE OF WORLD.

- ENCOUNTERS IZ NO SCALED TA YA PARTY OR YA DISTANCE FROM HOME. DA PLANET'S OWN LEVEL DECIDES, READABLE FROM ITS BIOSIGNATURE BEFORE YOU COMMIT
- DERE IZ NUTTIN' TA FORAGE. FOOD COMES FROM BUTCHERIN' LOCAL WILDLIFE
- A BODY STRIPPED OF ITS RESOURCES STAYS STRIPPED

IDENTIFIED SPECIES GO INTO DA BESTIARY'S ALIEN PAGE!

anomalies.title: ANOMALIES
anomalies.description:
EVERY STAR SYSTEM WIT PLANETS HAB AT LEAST ONE ANOMALOUS WORLD, MARKED WIT A QUESTION MARK.

HOLDIN' ORBIT OVER IT OFFERS TA INVESTIGATE, ONCE ONLY. WHAT FOLLOWS IZ A BRANCHIN' ENCOUNTER WRITTEN FOR DAT KIND OF WORLD, PAYIN' OUT IN A RELIC, IN SALVAGE, IN A FIGHT WIT SOMETINK NATIVE, OR IN NUTTIN'.

IT RUNS DA SAME ENGINE AS DA ADVENTURES ON EARTH'S MAP!

what_is_out_there.title: WHAT IZ OUT DERE
what_is_out_there.description:
STARS COME IN DA REAL CLASSES AN' IN A COUPLE OF DOZEN EXOTIC KINDS, EACH WIT ITS OWN MODEL: REMNANTS, BROWN DWARFS, FEEDIN' X-RAY BINARIES. SYSTEMS CAN BE BINARY OR HOLD SEVERAL STARS, EACH TRAVELLED TA INDIVIDUALLY.

BLACK HOLES COME IN THREE WEIGHTS, DA LARGEST BENDIN' DA LIGHT AROUND DEM AN' TRAILIN' A SPIRALLIN' ACCRETION STREAM. ROGUE PLANETS DRIFT BETWEEN DA STARS WIT NO SUN.

'BOUT TWENTY REAL NEBULAE SIT AT DEY REAL GALACTIC COORDINATES, HAND SHAPED: DA HORSEHEAD, DA ORION NEBULA, DA DARK NEBULAE. DYSON SPHERES EXIST.

ABOVE DA GALAXY DA MAP CONTINUES: LOCAL GROUP, SUPERCLUSTERS, COSMIC WEB FILAMENTS AN' DA SHELLS OF DA OBSERVABLE UNIVERSE.

OUR OWN SOLAR SYSTEM IZ HAND AUTHORED, WIT ITS TWELVE REAL BODIES, ITS BELTS AN' A SHELL OF ORBITAL DEBRIS!

patron_worlds.title: PATRON WORLDS
patron_worlds.description:
SOME WORLDS IN OTHER GALAXIES IZ NAMED AFTER DA PEOPLE WHO PAID FOR DA GAME. DEY IZ HABITABLE AN' LIFE BEARIN', DEY ORBIT EXOTIC OBJECTS, DEY SIT IN NINE PLANET SYSTEMS WHERE EVERY PLANET IZ A DIFFERENT TYPE, AN' DEY IZ LISTED IN DA STAR MAP CATALOGUE UNDER PATRONS.

EACH OF DOZE PEOPLE ALSO OWNS A HATCH ON EXACTLY ONE WORLD MAP SQUARE. IT NO CAN BE DISMANTLED AN' NUTTIN' GROWS OVER IT. GOING DOWN OPENS DEY HOLY PATRON BUNKER: A GREAT HALL WIT STRONGROOMS AN' A DEEP BACK CHAMBER, FILLED WIT MONEY AN' WEAPONS, WIT LOOT WEIGHTED TOWARD DA MOST EXPENSIVE ITEMS.

HATCH LOCATIONS IZ ENCRYPTED IN DA GAME DATA!

the_night_sky.title: DA NIGHT SKY
the_night_sky.description:
A NIGHT SKY CHART, SEPARATE FROM DA STAR MAP: A DRAGGABLE, ZOOMABLE PLANISPHERE WIT STARS SIZED BY MAGNITUDE, CONSTELLATIONS TRACED IN GOLD, A RIGHT ASCENSION AN' DECLINATION GRID, AN' A MILKY WAY BAND.

TAB SWITCHES BETWEEN CONSTELLATION SETS, EUROPEAN AN' CHINESE, WHICH TRACE DIFFERENT FIGURES OVER DA SAME STARS!

the_hypernet_desktop.title: DA HYPERNET DESKTOP
the_hypernet_desktop.description:
DA HYPERNET IZ A SIMULATED OPERATIN' SYSTEM OF DA PERIOD: DESKTOP, TASKBAR, START MENU, DRAGGABLE AN' RESIZABLE WINDOWS, AN' A SET OF APPLICATIONS.

IT HAB A VIRTUAL FILE SYSTEM AN' REGISTRY, BOTH STASHED INSIDE YA SAVEGAME, SO WRITTEN FILES AN' CHANGED FIDDLY BITS PERSIST.

- WASD OR ARROWS MOVE DA FOCUS RING, TAB CYCLES
- ENTER OR SPACE ACTIVATES
- ESCAPE LEAVES A TEXT FIELD, DEN CLOSES DA WINDOW, DEN EXITS
- ON A CONTROLLER: D-PAD NAVIGATES, A ACTIVATES, B CLOSES, DA LEFT STICK IZ A FREE CURSOR

app_hypernet_explorer.title: APP: HYPERNET EXPLORER
app_hypernet_explorer.description:
DA BROWSER. TABS WIT DEY OWN HISTORY, BACK, FORWARD, STOP, REFRESH AN' HOME, AN ADDRESS BAR WIT AUTOCOMPLETE, A LINKS BAR, AN EXPLORER BAR WIT SEARCH, FAVORITES AN' HISTORY, FIND ON PAGE, VIEW SOURCE, STASHIN' A PAGE, DOWNLOADS, PRINT PREVIEW, ZOOM, ENCODIN', A POP UP BLOCKER, MAIL AN' NEWS, AN' A 404 GATEWAY PAGE DAT SUGGESTS ALTERNATIVES.

EVERY PAGE IN DA ARCHIVE IZ A FULL DOCUMENT. PREFERENCES, FAVORITES, HISTORY AN' DOWNLOADS LIVE IN DA REGISTRY AN' IZ KEPT IN YA SAVEGAME!

app_my_computer.title: APP: ME COMPUTER
app_my_computer.description:
DA FILE EXPLORER. IT BROWSES DA VIRTUAL FILE SYSTEM: DRIVES, FOLDERS, ME DOCUMENTS, AN' EVERYTINK YOU OR AN APPLICATION HAB WRITTEN.

FILES OPEN IN WHICHEVER APPLICATION OWNS DEM: A TEXT FILE IN NOTEPAD, A STASHED WEB PAGE IN DA BROWSER!

app_notepad.title: APP: NOTEPAD
app_notepad.description: A PLAIN TEXT EDITOR WRITIN' INTO DA VIRTUAL FILE SYSTEM. NOTES TYPED HERE IZ STASHED IN YA SAVEGAME, CAN BE REOPENED, AN' CAN BE READ BY ANY APPLICATION DAT READS FILES!

app_control_panel.title: APP: CONTROL PANEL
app_control_panel.description:
MACHINE FIDDLY BITS. YA PARTY'S STATISTICS IZ PRESENTED AS HARDWARE SPECIFICATIONS. WALLPAPERS, DISPLAY FIDDLY BITS AN' DA REST OF DA CONFIGURATION LIVE HERE.

CHANGES IZ STORED IN DA REGISTRY!

app_tv_guide.title: APP: TV GUIDE
app_tv_guide.description:
DA TELEVISION LISTINGS, READ FROM DA BROADCAST DATABASE. BROWSE EVERY CHANNEL, ITS CAST AN' ITS PROGRAMMES.

SELECTIN' A PROGRAMME PLAYS ITS BROADCAST INLINE, A LINE EVERY COUPLE OF SECONDS, WITOUT LEAVIN' DA DESKTOP.

DA SCHEDULE REGENERATES EVERY IN GAME WEEK AN' IZ FIXED FOR DAT WEEK!

app_the_object_index.title: APP: DA OBJECT INDEX
app_the_object_index.description:
A CATALOGUE OF EVERY ITEM IN DA GAME, WIT A DOSSIER FOR EACH.

DA LEFT PAGE LISTS ITEMS BY CATEGORY, WIT A SEARCH BOX. DA RIGHT PAGE SHOWS DA DOSSIER: IDENTIFICATION, DESCRIPTION, TRADE, PHYSICAL PROPERTIES, FOOD VALUES, COMPOSITION AN' TAGS.

RANDOMIZE REWRITES DA DESCRIPTION FOR DIS WINDOW ONLY!

app_npolice.title: APP: N€POLICE
app_npolice.description:
DA CONTINENTAL POLICE PORTAL, FOR SETTLIN' YA CRIMINAL RECORD WITOUT WAITIN' TA BE CAUGHT.

- CASE FILE: EVERY CHARGE WIT ITS FINE, SETTLEABLE ONE AT A TIME OR ALL AT ONCE
- SELF-REPORT: CONFESS SOMETINK NO YET REGISTERED, AT HALF DA USUAL FINE
- CUSTODY: TURN YOURSELF IN, OR REQUEST A HEARIN' BEFORE ERIS

DA CUSTODY FIDDLY BITS CLOSE DA COMPUTER, COZ DA CELLS AN' DA COURTROOM IZ PLACES ON DA MAP!

app_eurodemics.title: APP: EURODEMICS
app_eurodemics.description:
DA PUBLIC TERMINAL OF DA CONTINENTAL EPIDEMIC OBSERVATORY, READIN' DA LIVE OUTBREAK GRIMORIE.

- SITUATION: OUTBREAKS RUNNIN', PEOPLE ILL, PEOPLE DEAD, TOWNS AFFECTED, AN' A READOUT OF WHERE YOU IZ STANDIN'
- OUTBREAKS: EVERY OUTBREAK BURNIN', EACH WIT ITS DAILY CURVE, REDRAWN AT MIDNIGHT, OVER DA TOWN BY TOWN TABLE
- ARCHIVE: OUTBREAKS DIS WORLD HAB CLOSED, PLUS DA EPIDEMICS AN' MASS HYSTERIAS OF DA LAST CENTURY

app_artifact_analyzer.title: APP: ARTIFACT ANALYZER
app_artifact_analyzer.description: ANALYSES PROCEDURAL ARTIFACTS AN' REPORTS WHAT DEY ACTUALLY DO!

app_token_exchange.title: APP: TOKEN EXCHANGE
app_token_exchange.description: CONVERTS EUROS INTO ARCADE TOKENS AN' BACK, AT DA SAME RATE AS DA PHYSICAL CONVERTER MACHINE!

the_hexphone.title: DA HEXPHONE
the_hexphone.description:
DA PARTY CARRIES A MOBILE PHONE: CREDIT, CONTACTS, CALL HISTORY, AN INBOX AN' A COUPLE OF BUILT IN GAMES.

CALLIN' A CONTACT TRIGGERS WHAT DAT PERSON DOES WHEN CALLED. INCOMIN' CALLS ARRIVE WIT AN ANSWER OR DECLINE PROMPT.

KEYPAD DIGITS DIAL AN' ACT AS SHORTCUTS, ENTER SELECTS, CALLS AN' OPENS, ESCAPE ENDS AN' GOES BACK.

PAYPHONES SHARE DA SAME CONTACTS AN' CREDIT GRIMORIE, BUT ONLY PLACE OUTGOIN' CALLS: NO INBOX, NO GAMES, NO INCOMIN' CALLS!

television.title: TELEVISION
television.description:
WATCH ANY TELEVISION YOU FIND. TUNIN' TA A CHANNEL PUTS YOU IN ITS STUDIO, WHERE DA CAST PERFORMS DA SHOW. SHOWS WIT NO CAST IZ NARRATED.

SHOWS TALK 'BOUT YA WORLD: DA HISTORY CHANNEL AN' DA NEWS COVER WHAT HAB ACTUALLY HAPPENED.

DA SCHEDULE CHANGES EVERY GAME WEEK, AN' EACH SHOW IZ DIFFERENT EVERY TIME YOU TUNE IN.

ADVERTS SELL EITHER PRODUCTS AT DEY REAL PRICE OR A POLITICAL MESSAGE.

WATCHIN' A WHOLE SHOW RAISES DA PARTY'S FUN, EXCEPT FOR TECHNOPHOBES, WHO LOSE FUN INSTEAD.

DA CHANNEL GUIDE IZ A TELETEXT PAGE!

the_radio.title: DA RADIO
the_radio.description:
RADIOS TUNE ACROSS IZ, FM AN' EM BANDS. DA STATIONS IZ BUILT FROM DA MUSIC FILES DA GAME SHIPS WIT, SO EVERY TRACK IZ SOMEWHERE ON DA DIAL.

LEFT AN' RIGHT CHANGE FREQUENCY, UP AN' DOWN CHANGE BAND, PAGE UP AN' PAGE DOWN SCAN, ENTER MARKS A FAVOURITE. BETWEEN STATIONS DERE IZ STATIC.

DA LAST STATION TUNED IZ REMEMBERED!

music_and_sound.title: MUSIC AN' SOUND
music_and_sound.description:
BATTLE MUSIC IZ CHOSEN IN FIDDLY BITS. RANDOM DRAWS A DIFFERENT TRACK AT DA START OF EVERY FIGHT, AN' NONE FIGHTS IN SILENCE.

MAP MUSIC IZ FIXED: ONE TRACK PER COMBINATION OF BIOME, NATION AN' TIME OF DAY. SOME MUSIC IZ GENERATED LIVE BY A PROCEDURAL SYSTEM.

EACH TRACK IZ ANNOUNCED WIT ITS TITLE AN' ARTIST, AS A NOTIFICATION OR A DRAWN CASSETTE.

FOOTSTEPS CHANGE WIT DA SURFACE UNDERFOOT!

diversions.title: DIVERSIONS
diversions.description:
DA 3D GAMES IZ SIMULATIONS RENDERED THROUGH A RETRO SHADER, AN' MOST IZ PLAYED WHERE YOU STAND: DA POOL TABLE, DA BASKETBALL COURT, DA BOWLIN' ALLEY AN' DA CHESS BOARD IZ DROPPED INTO DA SCENERY OF DA MAP YOU IZ ON.

PLAYIN' ANYTINK FEEDS DA WHOLE PARTY'S FUN. CONTROL HINTS IZ NO PRINTED; DA KEYS IZ DA ONES YOU ALREADY USE.

TWO PLAYERS CAN SHARE ALMOST ALL OF DEM. REAL TIME GAMES LET EITHER PLAYER STEER AN' TURN BASED GAMES BECOME HOT SEAT!

the_arcade_cabinet.title: DA ARCADE CABINET
the_arcade_cabinet.description:
ARCADE CABINETS TAKE TOKENS, BOUGHT WIT EUROS AT DA CONVERTER OR ON DA HYPERNET. A CABINET KEEPS HIGH SCORES WIT LETTER ENTRY AN' RUNS A DEMO WHEN IDLE.

EACH CART IZ A COMPLETE GAME, DRAWN IN COLOUR ASCII:

- SNAKE, AGAINST A RED COMPUTER SNAKE COMPETIN' FOR DA SAME APPLES
- MANPAC, A PELLET MAZE WIT THREE HUNTERS AN' POWER PILLS DAT MAKE DEM EDIBLE
- HOPPA, ACROSS ROADS AN' RIVERS TA FIVE HOME SLOTS
- ASTRO INTRUDERS, WIT DESTRUCTIBLE BARRIERS
- METEOROIDS, WIT SPLITTIN' ROCKS AN' A WRAPPIN' SCREEN
- WALLBREAKER, WIT FALLIN' CAPSULES
- CRAWLER, SPLITTIN' WHEN SHOT IN DA MIDDLE, WIT A SPIDER DAT EATS DA MUSHROOMS
- BUBBLE POP, COLOURS DAT STICK AN' CLUSTERS DAT FALL
- BOOT SEQUENCE, A CABINET BOOTIN' UP AN' DEN A SPACE TA WALK AROUND IN

bowling.title: BOWLIN'
bowling.description:
A 3D BOWLIN' ALLEY WIT REAL PIN PHYSICS.

DA CAMERA FOLLOWS DA BALL DOWN DA LANE AN' CUTS TA DA PINS ON IMPACT.

AIM, POWER AN' SPIN USE DA SAME MOVIN' SLIDER AS POOL AN' BASKETBALL!

pool.title: POOL
pool.description:
A NINE FOOT TABLE SIMULATED IN METRES. BALLS ROLL UNDER CLOTH FRICTION, THROW EACH OTHER OFF ON IMPACT, RATTLE IN DA JAWS OF A POCKET AN' DROP.

AIM, POWER AN' SPIN IZ SET WIT DA OSCILLATIN' SLIDER. DA TABLE IZ PLACED IN DA SCENERY AROUND YOU!

basketball.title: BASKETBALL
basketball.description:
A FREE THROW SHOOTOUT AGAINST A COMPUTER OPPONENT ON A HALF COURT.

DA BALL ARCS, BOUNCES OFF DA RIM AN' BACKBOARD, AN' GOES IN OR MISSES!

chess.title: CHESS
chess.description:
FULL RULES CHESS ON A LOW POLY 3D BOARD. EVERY PIECE IZ A CREATURE FROM DA 3D BATTLER SYSTEM, DEALT FROM DA WORLD SEED, SO ONE WORLD ALWAYS FIELDS DA SAME TWO ARMIES: A BRIGHT ONE FOR WHITE AN' A DARK ONE FOR BLACK.

TWO MODES: NORMAL CHESS AN' CHAOS!

fishing.title: FISHIN'
fishing.description:
FIRST PERSON FISHIN'. FISH, JUNK AN' HOSTILE ENCOUNTERS IZ BUILT BY DA SAME PROCEDURAL BATTLER SYSTEM DA BATTLES USE, SO A MEGALODON HOOKED IN DA LAKE IZ DA MEGALODON YOU DEN FIGHT.

AIM BY LOOKIN' AROUND. A RING ON DA WATER SHOWS WHERE DA CAST LANDS, DEN IT IZ A TUG OF WAR BETWEEN YA LINE AN' DA CATCH!

surfing.title: SURFIN'
surfing.description:
FIRST PERSON SURFIN'. WAVES BREAK ALONG DA BEACH, AN' DA WHITEWATER SWALLOWS DA WAVE BEHIND.

DA BOARD PITCHES AN' ROLLS. READ WHERE DA WAVE IZ BREAKIN' AN' STAY AHEAD OF IT!

the_shooting_range.title: DA SHOOTIN' RANGE
the_shooting_range.description:
A FIRST PERSON TARGET RANGE. DA WEAPONS HANDLE EXACTLY AS DEY DO IN BATTLE.

DA RANGE LENDS YOU DA WEAPON, SO YOU CAN TRY ONE BEFORE BUYIN' IT.

ONLY BOWS, THROWN WEAPONS AN' FIREARMS IZ AVAILABLE!

the_horse_race.title: DA HORSE RACE
the_horse_race.description:
A 3D TURF COURSE WIT RAILS, A STARTIN' GATE, A WINNIN' POST AN' A GRANDSTAND.

EACH HORSE'S LOOK COMES FROM ITS NAME, SO A HORSE WIT DA SAME NAME LOOKS DA SAME IN EVERY WORLD.

DA ODDS SHOWN IZ FAIR!

the_monster_tournament.title: DA MONSTER TOURNAMENT
the_monster_tournament.description:
A KNOCKOUT MONSTER TOURNAMENT TA BET ON. PICK A FIGHTER, BET TOKENS, AN' WATCH ONLY YA MONSTER'S FIGHTS.

DA FIGHTS USE DA REAL BATTLE RULES, DEN PLAY OUT IN A 3D ARENA.

BETTIN' DOES NO CHANGE DA OUTCOME!

slots,_scratch_cards_and_tarot.title: SLOTS, SCRATCH CARDS AN' TAROT
slots,_scratch_cards_and_tarot.description:
SLOT MACHINE: A CABINET WHOSE REELS IZ DRUMS. EACH SYMBOL IZ A PLATE ON A FACET OF A CYLINDER, SO A SPIN TURNS DA DRUM AN' A LANDIN' OVERRUNS ITS STOP AN' SPRINGS BACK. DA SYMBOLS COME FROM DA GAME'S ICON SET.

SCRATCH CARDS: PRINTED TICKETS RUBBED PANEL BY PANEL IN ANY ORDER, AN' DA CARD CAN BE TURNED IN DA LIGHT WHILE YOU DO IT.

TAROT TABLE: DA DECK RIFFLES, DA READER CUTS IT, DA CARDS FLY TA DEY POSITIONS FACE DOWN AN' TURN ONE AT A TIME!

the_piano.title: DA PIANO
the_piano.description:
A PLAYABLE THREE OCTAVE KEYBOARD, C3 TA B5. IT IZ PLAYED WIT DA TYPIN' KEYBOARD LAID OUT AS TWO MANUALS, WHITES ON ONE ROW AN' BLACKS ABOVE, WIT A GAMEPAD, OR WIT DA MOUSE. KEYS LIGHT AS DEY SOUND.

PLAYIN' IT FEEDS DA FUN NEED!

lockpicking.title: LOCKPICKIN'
lockpicking.description:
PICKIN' A LOCK IZ A FALLIN' BLOCK PUZZLE: A KEY BIT MUST FIT INTO A PARTLY PACKED KEYWAY, AN' DA LOCK'S DIFFICULTY SETS HOW HARD DA FIT IZ.

FAILURE CONSUMES A LOCKPICK. A SKELETON KEY SKIPS DA GAME AN' OPENS DA LOCK OUTRIGHT.

LOCKPICKIN' OPENS LOCKED DOORS AN' PARKED CARS. BEING CAUGHT AT IT IZ A CRIME!

hypertamer.title: HyperTamer
hypertamer.description:
A VIRTUAL PET ON A MONOCHROME LCD HANDSET, DRAWN FROM DA CREATURE DATABASE AN' GIVEN A PERSONALITY DAT CHANGES HOW IT BEHAVES.

IT RUNS ON REAL TIME: IT EATS, SLEEPS, PLAYS AN' CAN DIE OF NEGLECT, AN' TIME PASSES WHILE DA GAME IZ CLOSED. TRAININ' MINIGAMES RAISE ITS STATS AN' IT GROWS ACCORDINGLY!

the_card_game.title: DA CARD GAME
the_card_game.description:
A COLLECTIBLE CARD GAME WIT A COLLECTION, A DECK BUILDER AN' DUELS.

A CARD IZ A MONSTER, A WEAPON OR A PIECE OF ARMOUR FROM DA GAME'S DATABASE, PRINTED WIT FIVE STATS, STR, WIS, DEX, PSI AN' CON, EACH FROM 0 TA 13. DOZE NUMBERS IZ PERCENTILES AGAINST DAT CARD'S OWN ROSTER, NO RAW PARAMETERS. EQUIPMENT IZ BOLTED ONTO A MONSTER ALREADY ON DA BOARD AN' ITS VALUES IZ ADDED, CLAMPED TA 13.

A DECK IZ 9 TA 20 CARDS AN' MAY ONLY HOLD COPIES YOU OWN. A PLAYER WHO NEVER OPENS DA DECK BUILDER IZ DEALT DA BEST LEGAL DECK DEY COLLECTION ALLOWS.

A DUEL IZ THREE BY THREE. ON YA TURN YOU EITHER DRAW THREE CARDS OR PLACE ONE: A MONSTER ONTO A FREE TILE, OR GEAR ONTO ONE OF YA OWN MONSTERS, ONE WEAPON AN' ONE ARMOUR EACH.

WHEN DA LAST TILE IZ TAKEN, EVERY MONSTER LOOKS AT ITS FOUR ORTHOGONAL NEIGHBOURS, PICKS DA WEAKEST BAD 'UN AMONG DEM AN' FIGHTS IT. EVERY PAIRIN' IZ SCORED AGAINST ONE FROZEN SNAPSHOT OF DA BOARD AN' ALL DEATHS LAND TOGETHER. MOST STATS WON TAKES DA FIGHT, AN EQUAL COUNT DESTROYS BOTH. WHOEVER HAB MORE MONSTERS STANDIN' WINS, TIES BROKEN ON DA SUMMED STATS OF DA SURVIVORS.

BOOSTER PACKS HOLD SIX CARDS FROM ONE POOL, WEIGHTED SO DA LAST IZ NEVER COMMON.

CARDS IZ ALSO WON BY CAPTURIN' A CREATURE IN BATTLE. CAPTURE PICKS DA WEAKEST CREATURE STILL STANDIN', HELPED BY DA CASTER'S PSI AGAINST ITS OWN, AN' IZ IMPOSSIBLE AGAINST ANYTINK MORE DEN TEN LEVELS ABOVE YA MEDIAN. SUCCESS ADDS DA CARD AN' KILLS DA CREATURE, SO DA SPOILS STILL DROP!
